description: Country-specific phone scam intelligence for Bageo AI call assistant. Powers country-contextualized keyword weighting, Gemini Flash-Lite regional semantic review, and localized Stall Mode bait tactics. Updated via tools/scam_intel/update_country_scams.py before releases.

TW.name: Taiwan
TW.prevalence_note: 165 anti-fraud & Whoscall 2025-2026: fake police/prosecutor (安全帳戶・視訊筆錄), 7-11 賣貨便/好賣+ escrow verification + screen sharing, fast-approval loan fee/account-beautification scams, investment LINE groups, and fake utility/ETC/parcel fee links dominate.

scams.name: 假冒警察／檢察官／戶政事務所（安全帳戶・視訊筆錄）
scams.name_en: Fake police, prosecutor or household registry demanding safe account or video statement
scams.signals_en: Poses as household registry, police or prosecutor claiming the owner's ID or bank book appeared in a money-laundering case; demands secrecy, LINE video statement, cash handover to a clerk, or transfer to a supervised/safe account.
scams.legit_en: Real Taiwanese police, prosecutors or household offices send mailed summons to visit in person and never take LINE video statements, ask for secrecy, or inspect funds.
bait_tactics: 裝得很緊張配合，說存摺跟印章鎖在二樓鐵櫃裡、鑰匙塞在哪裡忘記了，請他等一下先慢慢講監管流程
故意聽錯案號或分機號碼，請他一個字一個字重新唸，順便細問公證金跟清查大概要幾天
說老花眼鏡找不到、手機字太小看不清楚，請他口頭一步一步慢慢教怎麼操作
sources: 刑事警察局打詐儀錶板

scams.name: 假網拍買家／賣貨便・好賣+・旋轉拍賣金流認證
scams.name_en: 7-11 Maihuobian / FamilyMart / Carousell seller payout verification & screen-sharing scam
scams.signals_en: Claims buyer could not check out on 7-11 Maihuobian, FamilyMart Haomai+ or Carousell because the seller lacks payout/escrow verification; fake bank agent calls to guide online banking transfer or LINE screen sharing.
scams.legit_en: Real marketplace support never calls via LINE or phone to verify seller bank balances, transfer test codes, or share screens.
bait_tactics: 裝作剛開始在網路賣二手東西很怕弄錯，慢慢問那個金流認證是一次性還是每筆都要簽
假裝網銀 App 一直卡在更新轉圈圈或密碼打錯被鎖住，問能不能換郵局存摺慢慢對
故意把轉帳驗證欄位講成備註欄，請他從頭再講一次步驟
假裝沒用過台灣Pay找不到綁定畫面，請他從下載哪一個圖示開始慢慢教

scams.name: 假借貸／免聯徵快速核貸／美化帳戶
scams.name_en: Fast-approval loan advance-fee or bank-account beautification scam
scams.signals_en: Promises guaranteed no-credit-check loan or debt consolidation, then asks to add LINE, pay an upfront guarantee/unlock fee, or mail ATM cards/passbooks to 'beautify cashflow'.
scams.legit_en: Real bank staff following up on a loan the owner actually applied for never ask for ATM cards, passwords, LINE fees, or cashflow packaging.
bait_tactics: 裝作剛好想整修房子很想借，但算術很慢，一直請他重算本利攤還每個月到底幾塊錢
慢慢問提前清償違約金怎麼算、開辦費能不能直接從撥款裡面扣、要準備哪些財力證明
假裝手邊沒有紙筆，請他等我翻抽屜找原子筆把方案一個字一個字抄下來

scams.name: 假冒台電・台水・ETC・健保・郵局包裹欠費斷電通知
scams.name_en: Fake Taipower, water, ETC toll, NHI card or Chunghwa Post urgent fee/cut-off call
scams.signals_en: Claims electricity/water will be cut off within hours, NHI card is locked for illegal drug claims, or ETC/parcel needs instant link payment or transfer to personal/virtual account.
scams.legit_en: Polite utility, building-management or courier calls merely reminding the owner to pay at a convenience store or official app by month-end with no cut-off threat, link or card request.
bait_tactics: 裝緊張說家裡冰箱塞滿冷凍年菜不能斷電，假裝翻抽屜找上個月的水電單核對電號
故意報錯地址樓層或車牌號碼，請他幫我查看到底是登記在誰名下
問能不能現在走路去巷口超商印單子繳，請他先別掛電話等我穿鞋子找零錢
假裝記不清楚哪一天上國道，請他幫忙查車牌跟經過哪個收費站

scams.name: 飆股老師帶單／抽籤申購墊付／虛擬幣穩賺群組
scams.name_en: Fake stock guru, IPO lottery margin or crypto guaranteed-profit LINE group
scams.signals_en: Pitches guaranteed-win stock club, unlimited IPO share lottery requiring urgent top-up transfer to avoid default, or cash courier deposit into a trading app.
scams.legit_en: Licensed Taiwanese securities brokers never guarantee profits, pool funds in private apps, or send cash couriers.
bait_tactics: 裝作手頭有一筆定存快到期很有興趣，但聽不懂股票術語，請他從什麼是融資跟抽籤慢慢解釋
一直問萬一跌了怎麼辦、獲利分成怎麼算、能不能先小額試個三千塊看看流程

CN.name: China
CN.prevalence_note: National Anti-Fraud Center reports impersonation of police/prosecutors with screen sharing, fake JD/Alipay credit-record cancellation, FaceTime/meeting app scams, Xianyu buyer escrow verification, and express-parcel double-refund scams.
CN.cross_border_note: +86 or +86-170/171 virtual-carrier calls reaching overseas Chinese speakers frequently impersonate embassies, customs, or courier desks.

scams.name: 冒充公检法／反诈中心（资金清查・屏幕共享）
scams.name_en: Fake police, prosecutor or anti-fraud center demanding screen share or safe account
scams.signals_en: Claims to be police or anti-fraud officer alleging identity theft or money laundering; demands Tencent Meeting / Zoom screen sharing, secrecy, or transfer to a safe inspection account.
scams.legit_en: Real community officers only invite residents to the local police station in person and never verify funds or share screens.
bait_tactics: 装作很慌张想配合，说手机太卡打不开视频会议软件，请他一步一步慢点说流程
假装去卧室翻找银行卡和老花镜，故意报错卡号位数请他帮忙核对

scams.name: 冒充京东白条・征信修复・百万保障自动扣费取消
scams.name_en: Fake credit-record repair or WeChat/Douyin 'Million Insurance' auto-debit cancellation
scams.signals_en: Claims WeChat/Alipay/Douyin 'Million Insurance' or old student loan will deduct monthly fees or ruin PBOC credit unless cancelled via screen sharing and transfer.
scams.legit_en: Real payment platforms never call to cancel free account protection or ask users to borrow and transfer money to clear credit.
bait_tactics: 装作怕扣钱很着急，慢慢问这个保障是什么时候开通的、每个月具体几号扣多少钱
假装手机网络信号断断续续、找不到设置入口，让他从头一步步讲清楚菜单名字
假装听不清是哪家保险公司，让他把保单编号和投保日期慢慢念一遍
sources: 人民银行征信中心提示

scams.name: 闲鱼卖家认证／快递丢件双倍理赔诈骗
scams.name_en: Xianyu seller deposit verification or lost-parcel double-compensation scam
scams.signals_en: Claims a parcel was lost/damaged and offers double payout via third-party link/screen share, or claims Xianyu buyer funds are frozen until seller pays deposit.
scams.legit_en: Ordinary couriers delivering a parcel at the door or settling claims strictly inside the official shopping app.
bait_tactics: 装作记不清买了哪件东西，让他核对快递单号和里面装的是什么商品
假装支付宝页面加载不出来，慢慢问理赔金额是怎么算出来的

US.name: United States
US.prevalence_note: FTC & Hiya 2025-2026: Medicare card/brace impersonation, IRS/SSA arrest-warrant & gift-card/crypto ATM scams, Amazon/Geek Squad refund + remote-access scams, and spoofed bank Zelle 'pay yourself' fraud lead losses.

scams.name: Medicare Card / Free Brace / Genetic Kit Scam
scams.name_en: Medicare card update, back brace or genetic testing kit scam
scams.signals_en: Unsolicited caller offering a new plastic/chip Medicare card, free back/knee brace, or DNA swab kit while asking for the owner's Medicare number, SSN or doctor details.
scams.legit_en: The owner's own clinic or pharmacy confirming an existing prescription or appointment without cold-calling for Medicare numbers.
bait_tactics: Act interested in the brace or new card, pretend your wallet is upstairs and slowly ask what colors or sizes the brace comes in
Mishear letters on the card and ask them to explain step by step how the chip card is different from the paper one

scams.name: IRS Back-Tax / Social Security Suspension Scam
scams.name_en: IRS back-taxes or Social Security number suspended warrant scam

red_flag_keywords.text: social security number has been suspended

scams.signals_en: Threatens arrest warrant or SSN suspension over unpaid taxes or a crime in Texas/border, demanding immediate payment via gift cards, wire, or crypto ATM.
scams.legit_en: Accountant or state office returning the owner's own tax inquiry without threats, gift cards, or arrest claims.
bait_tactics: Sound flustered and cooperative, ask them to slowly spell out which tax year had the math error while looking for reading glasses
Ask convoluted questions about deductions and payment forms while pretending your car keys are missing

scams.name: Amazon / Geek Squad Refund & Bank Zelle Safe-Account Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Amazon/Geek Squad unauthorized order or bank Zelle fraud-desk scam
scams.signals_en: Claims an unauthorized $999 iPhone/Geek Squad renewal hit the account, or spoofed bank fraud desk instructs victim to Zelle money 'to yourself' / safe locker or install AnyDesk.
scams.legit_en: Real card fraud desk asking yes/no whether a specific purchase was yours and offering to mail a replacement card, with no Zelle, code, or remote app.
bait_tactics: Act worried about the charge, pretend the banking or Amazon app is stuck loading on slow Wi-Fi, and ask every detail about the item model and shipping city
Pretend to misread screen buttons and ask them to walk through how Zelle reversal works from the beginning

scams.name: Unpaid Toll Road / E-ZPass Suspension Scam
scams.name_en: Fake E-ZPass or state toll agency threatening late penalty or license suspension
scams.signals_en: Claims an unpaid road toll will trigger immediate late fees or DMV registration suspension unless paid right now via link or card over the phone.
scams.legit_en: State toll agencies mail paper invoices and never demand instant phone/link card entry under registration threats.
bait_tactics: Act puzzled because you haven't driven on the highway in months and slowly describe two old cars in your garage to check which plate it was

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.prevalence_note: Action Fraud, Ofcom & Hiya: HMRC tax/NI arrest threats, bank Authorised Push Payment (APP) 'safe account' fraud, fake Amazon/Royal Mail calls, and WhatsApp/Indeed task job scams dominate.

scams.name: HMRC Tax Lawsuit / National Insurance Compromise
scams.name_en: HMRC unpaid tax arrest threat or National Insurance number compromised scam

red_flag_keywords.text: national insurance number has been compromised

scams.signals_en: Claims HMRC is filing a lawsuit or the owner's National Insurance number was compromised, demanding immediate transfer, gift vouchers, or pressing 1 for a caseworker.
scams.legit_en: Accountant or employer payroll discussing PAYE or tax codes calmly with no arrest threat or instant payment.
bait_tactics: Sound polite and scatterbrained, ask which P60 tax year is affected while pretending to rummage through a kitchen drawer of old letters
Ask them to explain slowly how the tax calculation works because you retired or changed jobs

scams.name: UK Bank Fraud Team 'Safe Account' (APP Fraud) & Card Courier
scams.name_en: Fake UK bank fraud team asking to move funds to a safe account or hand card to courier

red_flag_keywords.text: move your money to a safe account

scams.signals_en: Claims inside bank staff are corrupt or account is under attack; tells owner to transfer savings to a newly opened 'safe account', read a one-time passcode, or hand their bank card to a bike courier.
scams.legit_en: Genuine UK bank blocking a card and posting a new one without ever asking to move money to another account or send a courier.
bait_tactics: Pretend your card reader battery just died and you are looking for AAA batteries in the shed while asking how the safe account interest works
Slowly ask whether Faster Payments has a daily limit and pretend the mobile banking app keeps logging out

scams.name: Indeed / Recruitment WhatsApp Task Scam
scams.name_en: Fake recruiter asking to add WhatsApp for remote task/review work
scams.signals_en: Robocall or recruiter claiming to be from Indeed/Reed telling the owner to add a number on WhatsApp for easy daily pay doing app/hotel reviews that require crypto deposits.
scams.legit_en: A real recruiter discussing a specific CV application and scheduling an interview by email or office visit.
bait_tactics: Act keen on the extra income, pretend you don't know how to add contacts on WhatsApp and ask them to explain what the daily tasks look like

scams.name: Fake HMRC or police: arrest warrant and bailiffs
scams.name_en: Fake tax office or police threatening arrest
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as HMRC or the police says there is an arrest warrant over unpaid tax or a compromised National Insurance number and demands immediate payment.
scams.legit_en: HMRC and the police never threaten immediate arrest by phone or ask for payment in vouchers.
bait_tactics: Say the reading glasses are upstairs and ask which tax year it is about
Ask how the amount was worked out

scams.name: Fake broadband provider: line cut off today
scams.name_en: Fake broadband provider threatening to cut the line
scams.signals_en: A caller from a broadband provider or the regulator says the line will be cut off today and asks to install remote support software or confirm bank details.
scams.legit_en: Broadband providers never cut a line the same day by phone or ask for remote access.
bait_tactics: Say the router is in another room and ask what light should be showing
Ask what time the cut-off is planned

scams.name: High-Return Share & Crypto Cold-Call Scam
scams.name_en: Unsolicited High-Return Investment and Crypto Cold Call

red_flag_keywords.text: open a crypto wallet right now

scams.signals_en: Unsolicited caller pitches exclusive high-return opportunities in shares, cryptocurrency, foreign exchange, or commodities, using polished financial jargon and time-limited bonuses to force a rapid decision.
scams.legit_en: Authorised investment and financial services firms in the United Kingdom and Ireland do not cold-call members of the public with urgent high-yield offers, and legitimate firms can always be verified independently on official central bank or regulator.
bait_tactics: Right, hang on—could you spell the firm's registered name slowly so I can type it into the financial register?
My tablet battery is sitting on two percent and I can't find the charging lead anywhere in the study.
Wait a second, the page isn't loading on my mobile data—what was that firm reference number again?

JP.name: Japan
JP.prevalence_note: NPA (警察庁) 2025-2026 special fraud (特殊詐欺): SNS/LINE fake police arrest warrants (ニセ警察), Ore-ore family settlement money, municipal medical/tax ATM refund scams (還付金詐欺), and cash-card pickup fraud lead damages.
JP.cross_border_note: Calls from +1 / +44 / +800 international prefixes to Japanese numbers are heavily used by ニセ警察 (fake police) rings spoofing Prefectural Police.

scams.name: ニセ警察官・検察官・全銀協（口座悪用・LINE逮捕状・カード預かり）
scams.name_en: Fake Japanese police, prosecutor or bank association demanding safe transfer or cash card handover

red_flag_keywords.text: キャッシュカードを預かり
キャッシュカードの封印
警察庁のセキュリティアプリ

scams.signals_en: Poses as Prefectural Police Division 2, prosecutor or bank association saying the owner's account appeared in a fraud arrest; shows fake badge/warrant on LINE video, asks PIN, sends courier for cash cards, or demands fund-inspection transfer.
scams.legit_en: Real Japanese police ask citizens to visit the local station in person and never show warrants on LINE, ask PINs, collect cash cards, or transfer funds.
bait_tactics: とても驚いて協力するふりをしつつ、通帳を仏壇の奥にしまったまま場所が分からないと言って時間を稼ぐ
老眼鏡を探しているふりをして、事件の内容や手続きの流れを何度もゆっくり聞き返す
インターネットバンキングの使い方がよく分からないふりをして一つずつ説明させる
金地金はどこで買うのか全く分からないふりをして、重さや手数料の計算をゆっくり聞く
sources: 警察庁・SOS47特殊詐欺対策ページ

scams.name: オレオレ詐欺（かばん紛失・示談金・会社の資金補填）
scams.name_en: Ore-ore relative impersonation asking urgent cash for lost bag or settlement
context_keywords: 携帯の番号が変わった

red_flag_keywords.text: 代理の者が取りに行く

scams.signals_en: Pretends to be son/grandson saying their voice changed from a cold or phone changed, lost a work bag/cheque or needs urgent settlement cash picked up by a 'colleague'.
scams.legit_en: Saved family contact chatting normally without secret cash couriers or urgent third-party transfers.
bait_tactics: 心配しているふりをして、いつどこで失くしたのか・上司の名前は誰なのかゆっくり詳しく聞く
銀行に行く支度をしているふりをして、金額の内訳やどうやって返す予定か長々と質問する

scams.name: 還付金詐欺（市役所・医療費・保険料のATM操作）
scams.name_en: Municipal medical or insurance refund scam guiding victim to an ATM
scams.signals_en: Claims to be city hall health/insurance desk saying a medical or insurance refund expires today and tells the owner to bring their cash card to an ATM and call back while pressing buttons.
scams.legit_en: Genuine municipal notices handled by mailed form, never by operating an ATM on the phone.
bait_tactics: 還付金があると聞いて喜ぶふりをし、いつの病院代の分か・書類は何色の封筒だったか細かく尋ねる
足が悪くてすぐATMに行けないと言い、計算方法や別の受け取り方をゆっくり説明させる

KR.name: South Korea
KR.prevalence_note: FSS (금융감독원) & KNPA: Prosecutor/FSS impersonation (서울중앙지검·대포통장·안전계좌·악성 원격앱), low-interest refinancing loan scams (대환대출), card-delivery impersonation (카드 배송원 사칭), and broken-phone family scams dominate.
KR.cross_border_note: 070 internet numbers and overseas prefixes relayed into Korean 010 numbers are heavily used in voice phishing.

scams.name: 검찰·금감원·카드배송원 사칭（대포통장·안전계좌·원격제어）
scams.name_en: Fake Seoul prosecutor, FSS or card courier leading to safe-account or remote-app phishing
scams.signals_en: Poses as Seoul Central Prosecutor/FSS or fake credit-card courier ('an unrequested card was issued') routing victim to fake customer service and prosecutors demanding remote apps or safe-account transfers.
scams.legit_en: Real parcel/card delivery simply confirming drop-off address with no fake customer-service phone number, remote app, or prosecutor transfer.
bait_tactics: 깜짝 놀라 협조하려는 척하면서 돋보기를 찾느라 시간이 걸린다며 사건 경위를 천천히 다시 설명해 달라고 하기
스마트폰 조작이 서툰 척하며 화면에 뭐가 떠 있는지 모르겠다고 절차부터 자세히 물어보기
어떤 은행 카드인지 기억이 안 난다며 카드 색깔과 신청 날짜를 천천히 다시 확인해 달라고 하기

scams.name: 저금리 대환대출·정부지원 서민대출 빙자 사기
scams.name_en: Fake government-backed low-interest refinancing loan demanding prior loan payoff
scams.signals_en: Offers low-interest government refinancing, then claims applying violated an existing loan contract and demands immediate cash repayment to a designated account or installing a KakaoTalk APK.
scams.legit_en: Owner's own bank calmly answering a loan inquiry the owner initiated without cash-repayment threats or APK files.
bait_tactics: 금리가 낮아진다니 관심이 많은 척하며 월 상환액과 중도상환수수료를 하나하나 다시 계산해 달라고 하기
서류를 적어두겠다며 볼펜과 종이를 찾는 척 천천히 조건을 되묻기

DE.name: Germany
DE.prevalence_note: Bundesnetzagentur, Polizei-Beratung & Hiya: Sweepstakes notary-fee scams (Gewinnspiel-Betrug), shock calls / Enkeltrick bail demands (Schockanruf), fake police safekeeping valuables, and Europol robocalls dominate.

scams.name: Gewinnspiel-Betrug & Gewinnspiel-Abo（Notar / Gebühren）
scams.name_en: Sweepstakes win demanding upfront notary/tax fees or fake lottery subscription trap
scams.signals_en: Congratulates owner on winning cash/car and demands upfront notary, tax or transport fee (often in gift cards or transfer), or claims a lottery subscription renewed unless IBAN is given to cancel.
scams.legit_en: Ordinary delivery or shop call about an item the owner actually ordered, with no upfront prize fee or IBAN demand.
bait_tactics: Sich begeistert über den Gewinn zeigen und langsam fragen, wie der Geldtransporter oder Notar genau abläuft
Vorgeben, die Lesebrille und die Bankkarte im anderen Zimmer zu suchen, während man nach Steuerdetails fragt

scams.name: Schockanruf, Enkeltrick & Falsche Polizisten（Kaution / Wertsachen）
scams.name_en: Shock call claiming fatal crash bail (Kaution) or fake police collecting valuables
scams.signals_en: Crying relative / fake officer claims a family member caused a fatal crash and needs instant bail cash/gold ('Kaution'), or claims burglars have the owner's address on a list and police must pick up valuables.
scams.legit_en: Real German local authorities or clinics scheduling an in-person visit without ever asking for bail cash, gold, or valuables.
bait_tactics: Erschrocken und kooperativ klingen, langsam nach dem genauen Unfallort und den Formalitäten fragen
So tun, als wüsste man den Zahlencode vom Tresor nicht mehr auswendig und müsste erst im Ordner nachsehen
Langsam fragen, wie die Quittung bei der Übergabe aussieht, während man angeblich den Schlüssel sucht

scams.name: Falsche Polizeibeamte holen Wertsachen ab
scams.name_en: Fake police officers collecting valuables
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says burglars or a corrupt bank employee threaten the owner's savings, asks for secrecy and says a plain-clothes officer will collect cash and valuables.
scams.legit_en: German police never collect money or valuables at the door and never ask people to keep a call secret from their bank.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass der Schlüssel zum Schrank bei der Nachbarin liegt, und fragen, wann der Kollege kommen will
Ruhig fragen, wie der Kollege aussieht

ES.name: Spain
ES.prevalence_note: INCIBE, OCU & Hiya: Double-call electricity/gas supplier switching & fake cut-off threats (Endesa/Iberdrola/CUPS), fake bank 'cuenta segura' & reverse-Bizum fraud, and InfoJobs/WhatsApp task job scams lead reports.

scams.name: Suplantación eléctrica / doble llamada（CUPS・corte de luz）
scams.name_en: Fake electricity supplier or double-call tariff switch demanding CUPS/IBAN or threatening cut-off
scams.signals_en: Claims urgent meter fault, immediate power cut-off, or bogus 20% tariff hike endorsed by OCU to extract DNI, CUPS code, IBAN, or SMS contract signature.
scams.legit_en: Polite utility or technician confirming a scheduled meter appointment or routine bill payable in the official client portal.
bait_tactics: Mostrar preocupación por la subida o el corte, fingir que busca una factura antigua en el cajón para mirar la potencia contratada
Equivocarse leyendo números del recibo y pedir que expliquen despacio cómo funciona el tramo horario

scams.name: Falso gestor bancario y estafa del Bizum inverso
scams.name_en: Fake Spanish bank manager demanding safe-account transfer or reverse Bizum payment request
scams.signals_en: Fake bank security alerts owner to fraudulent card charge and asks for SMS code or transfer to a 'cuenta segura', or buyer sends a Bizum money *request* pretending it is a payment.
scams.legit_en: Real bank risk desk blocking a suspicious card without asking for SMS codes, Bizum acceptance, or transfers.
bait_tactics: Fingir que la aplicación del banco se está actualizando muy lento y pedir todos los detalles del supuesto comercio
Preguntar despacio qué diferencia hay entre enviar y recibir en Bizum porque no encuentra las gafas

scams.name: Falso soporte técnico: control remoto
scams.name_en: Fake tech support with remote control
scams.signals_en: A caller from a software company says the computer sends virus alerts and asks to install a remote-control program and pay for a security renewal.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Decir que el ordenador arranca muy lento y preguntar qué debería salir en la pantalla
Preguntar qué mensaje de error han recibido

FR.name: France
FR.prevalence_note: Cybermalveillance.gouv.fr, DGCCRF & Hiya: Fake bank advisor + Secur'Pass/card-courier fraud (faux conseiller bancaire), Enedis/Linky electricity scams, and CPF / MaPrimeRénov' subsidy scams dominate.

scams.name: Faux conseiller bancaire（Secur'Pass・compte sécurisé・coursier）
scams.name_en: Fake French bank fraud advisor asking Secur'Pass validation, safe transfer or card courier
scams.signals_en: Impersonates bank anti-fraud unit claiming suspicious foreign payments; asks owner to validate a Secur'Pass/Clé Digitale prompt, wire funds to a safe account, or hand card to a courier.
scams.legit_en: Real bank advisor blocking a card and mailing a new one without ever asking to validate mobile prompts, wire funds, or hand over cards.
bait_tactics: Faire semblant que l'application bancaire tourne dans le vide faute de réseau et demander lentement les détails de l'opération
Demander comment fonctionne le plafond de virement en cherchant ses lunettes dans le salon
Dire que aucune notification ne s'affiche sur le téléphone et demander d'attendre pendant qu'on redémarre le Wi-Fi

scams.name: Usurpation Enedis / compteur Linky & aides MaPrimeRénov' / CPF
scams.name_en: Fake Enedis/Linky meter cut-off or MaPrimeRénov'/CPF subsidy call asking for RIB
scams.signals_en: Claims mandatory Linky update / imminent power cut-off or expiring CPF / energy-renovation state grant to obtain RIB/IBAN, FranceConnect login, or SMS signature.
scams.legit_en: Scheduled Enedis technician visit or energy provider reminding of a normal bill in the customer space without asking for RIB or FranceConnect codes.
bait_tactics: Se montrer intéressé mais confus, chercher une vieille facture EDF pour retrouver le numéro de point de livraison
Poser plein de questions lentes sur les conditions techniques et les délais

scams.name: Faux conseiller CPF : débloquer vos droits
scams.name_en: Fake training account adviser
scams.signals_en: A caller says the owner's training account rights expire and asks for the social security number or FranceConnect login to unlock them.
scams.legit_en: The training account service never calls to unlock rights and never asks for FranceConnect logins.
bait_tactics: Dire qu'on cherche ses lunettes et demander combien il reste sur le compte
Demander quelle formation ils proposent

scams.name: Fausse Assurance maladie : renouveler la carte Vitale
scams.name_en: Fake health insurance card renewal
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the health insurance says the Vitale card must be renewed or a refund is waiting and asks for ameli logins or card details for a small fee.
scams.legit_en: The health insurance never asks for ameli logins or card details by phone and the Vitale card is free.
bait_tactics: Dire que la carte est dans le portefeuille dans l'autre pièce et demander pourquoi il faut la renouveler
Demander combien coûtent les frais

scams.name: Faux support technique : contrôle à distance
scams.name_en: Fake tech support with remote control
scams.signals_en: A caller from a software company says the computer is infected and asks to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer, then charges for a fake repair.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Dire que l'ordinateur démarre très lentement et demander ce qu'il faut voir à l'écran
Demander quel message d'erreur ils ont reçu

BR.name: Brazil
BR.prevalence_note: Febraban, Anatel & Truecaller/Hiya: Fake bank central 0800 + PIX safe-account / remote-access ('mão fantasma'), wrong-PIX return scam (Golpe do PIX errado), and fake Receita Federal CPF fee scams dominate.

scams.name: Falsa Central Bancária 0800 / Golpe do PIX e Mão Fantasma
scams.name_en: Fake Brazilian bank 0800 fraud desk asking PIX to safe account or security-module app

red_flag_keywords.text: transferir via pix para conta segura

scams.signals_en: Poses as bank security desk alerting to an unauthorized purchase/PIX; tells owner to transfer balance to a 'conta segura', scan a QR code, or install a 'módulo de segurança' remote app.
scams.legit_en: Real Brazilian bank confirming or blocking a transaction in-app without ever asking for PIX transfers, tokens, or app downloads.
bait_tactics: Fingir preocupação, dizer que o aplicativo do banco está pedindo atualização e demorando para abrir no Wi-Fi
Perguntar devagar em qual cidade foi a compra suspeita e como funciona o estorno passo a passo

scams.name: Golpe do PIX Errado & Falsa Taxa da Receita Federal / CPF
scams.name_en: Wrong-PIX return to third-party key scam or fake Receita Federal CPF suspension PIX fee
scams.signals_en: Caller claims they sent a PIX by mistake and pressures owner to send a new PIX to a different third-party key (before triggering MED chargeback), or threatens CPF suspension unless a Receita fee is paid by PIX.
scams.legit_en: Accountant or bank discussing normal tax documents without urgent PIX fees or third-party return keys.
bait_tactics: Dizer que está tentando abrir o extrato para conferir o horário exato mas o celular travou
Pedir para soletrar devagar o banco de origem e explicar como aparece no comprovante

PT.name: Portugal
PT.prevalence_note: Polícia Judiciária & Banco de Portugal: MB WAY marketplace/code scams, fake bank/Polícia Judiciária safe-account calls, and fake CTT/EDP urgent payment calls lead phone fraud.

scams.name: Burla MB WAY（OLX / Vinted・associar número・pedido de dinheiro）
scams.name_en: Portuguese MB WAY marketplace scam asking to link phone number or accept money request
scams.signals_en: Fake buyer or courier on OLX/Vinted asks seller to enter the scammer's phone number on MB WAY / Multibanco, share a cardless withdrawal code, or accept a 'Pedir Dinheiro' prompt.
scams.legit_en: Real buyer arranging in-person pickup or standard delivery without asking for MB WAY codes or ATM linking.
bait_tactics: Fingir que nunca usou o MB WAY antes e pedir para explicar com muita calma para que serve cada botão da aplicação
Dizer que a aplicação deu erro de ligação e perguntar detalhes sobre quem vem buscar a encomenda

scams.name: Falso banco: código recebido por SMS
scams.name_en: Fake bank asking for the SMS code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank says the account is blocked or a payment is suspicious and asks for the code received by SMS or the homebanking credentials.
scams.legit_en: Portuguese banks never ask for SMS codes or homebanking credentials by phone.
bait_tactics: Dizer que a aplicação do banco está a atualizar e pedir para explicar outra vez
Perguntar de que pagamento se trata

scams.name: MB Way: dinheiro enviado por engano
scams.name_en: MB Way money sent by mistake
scams.signals_en: A caller says they sent money by mistake and asks the owner to return it to another number or to enter a PIN in MB Way to receive it.
scams.legit_en: No one needs a PIN to receive money in MB Way.
bait_tactics: Dizer que o telemóvel está a carregar e perguntar quanto foi enviado
Perguntar a que horas foi

scams.name: Olá pai, olá mãe: número novo e pagamento urgente
scams.name_en: Child with a new number asking for an urgent payment

red_flag_keywords.text: este é o meu número novo

scams.signals_en: A caller or message says it is a son or daughter whose phone broke and who has a new number, and asks for an urgent payment.
scams.legit_en: Children who change numbers can be reached on the old one; an urgent payment request is the warning sign.
bait_tactics: Dizer que os óculos ficaram no carro e perguntar de que pagamento se trata
Perguntar quanto é exatamente

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.prevalence_note: OJK, Komdigi & Truecaller/Hiya: Highest spam/scam call rate globally (~79-89%). Bank/OJK/DJP Pajak (Coretax) impersonation demanding OTP, APK install or 'rekening aman', and prize 'biaya admin' scams dominate.
ID.cross_border_note: Cross-border alert: +62 numbers calling foreign SIMs (especially TW, JP, KR, HK) are frequently spoofed VoIP routes used by cross-border fraud rings.

scams.name: Penipuan Bank / OJK / Pajak Coretax（OTP・APK・Rekening Aman）
scams.name_en: Fake Indonesian bank, OJK or DJP Coretax officer demanding OTP, APK install or safe account
scams.signals_en: Impersonates bank (BRI/BCA/Mandiri), OJK, or DJP Coretax claiming fee hike (`perubahan tarif Rp150.000`) or tax update; asks for OTP, WhatsApp `.apk` install, or transfer to `rekening aman`.
scams.legit_en: Official bank or tax notice directing users only to in-branch service or official domain without OTP, APK, or personal transfers.
bait_tactics: Berpura-pura sinyal HP lemah dan aplikasi mobile banking sedang loading lama, minta dijelaskan pelan-pelan dari awal
Pura-pura mencari kacamata baca sambil bertanya detail perhitungan biaya tersebut
Berpura-pura lupa nomor NPWP dan sedang membongkar map dokumen lama di lemari

scams.name: Penipuan Undian Hadiah（Biaya Admin / Pajak Pemenang）
scams.name_en: Indonesian prize/giveaway scam demanding upfront admin or winner tax fee
scams.signals_en: Congratulates victim on winning a bank/telecom/e-commerce giveaway and demands upfront transfer of `biaya admin` or winner tax before releasing the prize.
scams.legit_en: Ordinary courier delivering an actual package without demanding prize admin fees.
bait_tactics: Berpura-pura senang menang hadiah, tanya warna hadiahnya dan apakah biaya admin bisa dipotong langsung dari hadiahnya

IT.name: Italy
IT.prevalence_note: Polizia Postale & CERTFin 2025-2026: fake PostePay/bank anti-fraud alerts (spoofed SMS codes, bonifico istantaneo) and finto maresciallo / Carabinieri relative-accident bail or safe-account scams dominate.

scams.name: Finto Maresciallo dei Carabinieri / Polizia Postale (Conto Sicuro o Cauzione)
scams.name_en: Fake Italian Carabinieri / Polizia Postale demanding bail or safe-account transfer

red_flag_keywords.text: spostare i soldi su conto sicuro

scams.signals_en: Claims a relative caused an accident or an investigation found cloned accounts; demands immediate cash/jewelry handover for bail or wire to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Real Carabinieri or Polizia Postale never ask for cash bail, PostePay codes, or transfers to safe accounts over the phone.
bait_tactics: Chiedere di ripetere lentamente il numero di protocollo perché non si trovano gli occhiali da lettura
Dire che l'app della banca non si apre per mancanza di campo e chiedere di spiegare tutto con calma

scams.name: Finto Servizio Antifrode / PostePay (Bonifico Istantaneo & OTP)
scams.name_en: Fake Italian bank or PostePay fraud desk asking for OTP or instant transfer
scams.signals_en: Impersonates bank or Poste Italiane anti-fraud team warning of an unauthorized debit; pressures user to read a one-time code or authorize an instant transfer.
scams.legit_en: Real Italian banks block a card directly without ever asking for SMS OTPs or instant transfers to cancel a charge.
bait_tactics: Chiedere di leggere cifra per cifra la data e l'importo dell'operazione sospetta mentre si cerca la carta nel cassetto

scams.name: Teleselling energia: codice POD e consenso vocale
scams.name_en: Energy teleselling asking for the POD code and voice consent
scams.signals_en: A caller from an energy supplier asks to read the POD code from the bill and to record a voice consent, sometimes threatening a supply cut.
scams.legit_en: Suppliers cannot switch a contract without written confirmation and never threaten a cut during a sales call.
bait_tactics: Dire che la bolletta è nell'altra stanza e chiedere quanto si risparmia al mese
Chiedere quanto dura l'offerta

IN.name: India
IN.prevalence_note: I4C / RBI & TRAI 2025-2026: 'Digital arrest' impersonation of CBI/customs/narcotics over video call, TRAI SIM-block threats, and bank KYC update APK/OTP scams dominate.

scams.name: डिजिटल अरेस्ट / नकली सीबीआई व कस्टम पार्सल धमकी
scams.name_en: Fake Indian CBI / customs digital arrest and parcel seizure scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonates CBI, police, narcotics or customs claiming an illegal parcel in the victim's name; threatens 'digital arrest' and demands bail/verification transfer.
scams.legit_en: Indian law enforcement never conducts video-call arrests or asks for bail/verification money transfers over a call.
bait_tactics: बोलें कि फोन का नेटवर्क बहुत कमजोर है और आवाज कट रही है, धीरे से दोबारा पूरी बात समझाइए
कहें कि चश्मा दूसरे कमरे में रखा है और कागज-कलम ढूंढकर सब नोट करना है

scams.name: बैंक केवाईसी अपडेट व एनीडेस्क / ओटीपी ठगी
scams.name_en: Indian bank KYC block threat demanding OTP or remote APK install
scams.signals_en: Claims bank account or SIM will be blocked tonight unless KYC/PAN is updated via a WhatsApp APK link or spoken OTP.
scams.legit_en: Genuine banks conduct KYC updates in-branch or via their official portal without requesting OTPs or WhatsApp APKs.
bait_tactics: बोलें कि फोन हैंग हो गया है और स्क्रीन खुलने में बहुत समय लग रहा है

HK.name: Hong Kong
HK.prevalence_note: ADCC and OFCA 2025-2026: fake mainland police or Immigration officers demanding secrecy and asset checks, fake courier or Customs parcel holds with clearance fees, and 'guess who' relatives needing bail cash dominate.

scams.name: 假冒內地公安／入境處職員（保密令・資產清查）
scams.name_en: Fake mainland police or Immigration staff demanding secrecy and an asset check
scams.signals_en: Poses as mainland public security or HK Immigration staff saying the owner's phone card or ID is tied to cross-border money laundering; demands secrecy, a video statement, an asset check or a transfer to a 'safe account'.
scams.legit_en: Real HK police or Immigration staff ask the owner to come to a station or office in person and never demand secrecy orders, asset checks or transfers by phone.
bait_tactics: 扮好緊張咁配合，話身份證同銀行簿擺咗喺抽屜底要慢慢搵，請佢先講清楚保密令點運作
扮聽唔清楚案件編號同部門名，請佢一個字一個字再講，順便問資產清查要幾耐

scams.name: 假冒速遞公司／海關扣件（補繳清關手續費）
scams.name_en: Fake courier or Customs parcel hold demanding a clearance fee
scams.signals_en: Poses as a courier or Customs saying a parcel in the owner's name holds contraband or is held, then demands a clearance fee by link or card, or passes the call to 'law enforcement'.
scams.legit_en: Real couriers call about delivery times or addresses for parcels the owner expects; duties are paid through the courier's own app or on delivery, without threats.
bait_tactics: 扮好擔心，話唔記得最近有冇網購，請佢逐件講包裹入面有咩
話信用卡唔喺身邊要去另一間房搵，請佢先慢慢解釋清關手續費點計

scams.name: 猜猜我是誰／假冒親友急需保釋金
scams.name_en: 'Guess who' relative with a new number urgently needing bail cash
scams.signals_en: Plays a relative with a new number or a sore throat, then claims to be held after a crash and urgently needs bail or a settlement, sending a 'friend' to collect cash or asking for a transfer.
scams.legit_en: A real relative who changed numbers chats normally and can answer family questions; they do not ask for urgent bail cash or a courier at the door.
bait_tactics: 扮好關心，問佢最近食咗咩、屋企啲親戚近況，慢慢傾
話要去銀行先有現金但唔記得提款卡放喺邊，請佢慢慢講保釋金點交收

scams.name: 假冒平台客服取消自動扣費騙案
scams.name_en: Fake Platform Customer Service Auto-Deduction Cancellation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller speaks Putonghua or accented Cantonese claiming to represent a shopping, short-video, or payment platform, stating the user enabled a paid membership or insurance plan that will deduct hefty monthly fees tonight.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate e-commerce, payment, and media platforms allow users to manage subscriptions directly inside their official apps and never telephone customers to request bank transfers, one-time passwords, or live screen sharing to cancel fees.
bait_tactics: 奇怪，我平時很少用那個平台，你等我找一下舊手機看看當初是用哪個電郵登記的。
我現在打開網上銀行一直轉圈載入不出來，公司網路好像擋住了，還是我自己進官方應用程式按取消？
你說今晚會扣款是嗎？但我這張卡裡面本來就只剩幾十塊錢，應該扣不到吧？

scams.name: 猜猜我是誰假冒親友急需保釋金騙案
scams.name_en: Guess Who I Am Relative Emergency Bail Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller opens vaguely by asking the recipient to guess who is speaking and claims they lost their phone or changed numbers.
scams.legit_en: Real police stations, courts, and hospitals in Hong Kong and Macau never phone family members to demand instant transfers to personal accounts or send couriers to collect cash bail on the street.
bait_tactics: 你聲音聽起來感冒很重，我實在聽不出來是哪位親戚，你先講你叫什麼名字？
這麼大件事我一個人做不了主，我現在先打去你原本那個舊電話號碼確認一下。
我今天沒帶提款卡出門，銀行櫃檯這個鐘點也排滿人，你要不要先找家裡其他人幫忙？

scams.name: 假冒電訊及郵電部門停機騙案
scams.name_en: Telecom Authority Urgent Service Termination Scam
scams.signals_en: The call claims to come from the local communications or postal-telecom authority, warning that the recipient's mobile service will be suspended within two hours because a SIM card registered under their name sent fraudulent messages elsewhere.
scams.legit_en: Telecommunications regulators in Hong Kong and Macau do not call individual subscribers about billing or line suspension, never ask for identity numbers over unsolicited calls, and never route calls to police investigators.
bait_tactics: 這個門號是我用了好幾年的月費卡，怎麼會突然停機？你把通知書寄到我帳單地址吧。
我現在手頭正在開會沒辦法抄寫，我自己下班後走去門市櫃檯查清楚好了。
你說我在外地開了電話卡，那你先告訴我開卡日期是幾月幾號，我完全沒印象。

CA.name: Canada
CA.prevalence_note: Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre 2025-2026: fake CRA or Service Canada agents threatening arrest over a 'compromised SIN', fake CBSA parcel holds, and grandparent emergency scams with cash couriers dominate.

scams.name: Fake CRA / Service Canada (compromised SIN, arrest threat)
scams.name_en: Fake Canada Revenue Agency or Service Canada agent threatening arrest over a compromised SIN
scams.signals_en: Poses as CRA or Service Canada saying the owner's SIN is compromised or taxes are unpaid and the RCMP will arrest them unless they pay at once by gift cards, crypto ATM or e-Transfer.
scams.legit_en: Real CRA and Service Canada contact people mostly by mail or My Account messages and never threaten arrest or ask for gift cards, crypto or e-Transfers.
bait_tactics: Sound worried and ask them to explain slowly which tax year it is about while you look for your old tax papers
Say your SIN card is in a drawer somewhere and keep asking which office and agent number to write down

scams.name: Grandparent scam (bail money, cash courier)
scams.name_en: Grandparent emergency scam asking for bail money through a cash courier
scams.signals_en: A 'grandchild' or a 'lawyer' says the grandchild crashed a car and sits in jail, needs bail money now, asks to keep it secret from the parents and sends a courier for cash.
scams.legit_en: Real family emergencies come with names and details the family can check, and courts never send couriers to collect bail cash at the door.
bait_tactics: Act shaken and ask the 'grandchild' about family things while you look for your reading glasses
Ask slowly how the courier will find the house and what the receipt will look like

scams.name: Fake CBSA intercepted parcel
scams.name_en: Fake Canada Border Services Agency call about an intercepted parcel in the owner's name
scams.signals_en: Poses as CBSA saying a parcel in the owner's name with drugs or illegal bank cards was intercepted, then transfers to 'police' and asks for money to clear their name.
scams.legit_en: Real couriers and CBSA notices about parcels the owner expects ask only for duties through the courier, with no threats or transfers to police.
bait_tactics: Sound confused and ask them to read out every item and the sender's address slowly
Say you have to find the shipping email first and ask what the parcel looked like

AU.name: Australia
AU.prevalence_note: Scamwatch and ATO 2025-2026: fake ATO / myGov arrest threats, fake bank fraud teams asking for NetCodes and moves to a 'safe account', and fake toll or parcel fee calls dominate.

scams.name: Fake ATO / myGov (arrest warrant, holding account)
scams.name_en: Fake Australian Taxation Office or myGov caller threatening arrest over a tax debt
scams.signals_en: Poses as the ATO or myGov saying the owner owes tax or their tax file number is compromised, threatening arrest unless money moves to a 'federal holding account' or is paid by gift cards or crypto.
scams.legit_en: The real ATO never threatens arrest on the phone or asks for gift cards, crypto or transfers to a holding account; it sends letters and myGov messages.
bait_tactics: Sound worried and ask which tax return it is about while you look for your old paperwork
Ask them to spell the officer's name and the reference number slowly so you can write it down

scams.name: Fake bank fraud team (NetCode, safe account)
scams.name_en: Fake bank fraud team asking for a NetCode and a move to a safe account
scams.signals_en: Poses as a bank's fraud team about suspicious charges, asks the owner to read out the NetCode or one-time code just sent, set up a new PayID or move savings to a 'safe account'.
scams.legit_en: Real Australian banks may call about a card but never ask for NetCodes or one-time codes, new PayIDs or moving money to another account.
bait_tactics: Say the phone is slow to show messages and ask them to explain again what the code is for
Ask slowly which charges they mean and when they happened while you find your statement

scams.name: Fake Linkt overdue toll
scams.name_en: Fake Linkt toll call about an overdue toll notice
scams.signals_en: Says the owner has an overdue toll and faces a fine unless they pay now through a link or by card over the phone.
scams.legit_en: Real toll operators send notices by mail or through the owner's account and do not demand card details on an unexpected call.
bait_tactics: Ask which road and date the toll was for while you look for the car papers
Say you have two cars and ask them to describe the plate slowly

scams.name: Remote Access Tech and Broadband Scam
scams.name_en: Remote Access IT and Telecommunications Support Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: log into your online banking to check

scams.signals_en: Callers claim to represent a telecommunications provider, internet service team, or computer security department, warning that the recipient's broadband line or computer has been hacked.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate telecommunications carriers and software providers in Australia and New Zealand never make unsolicited phone calls asking users to install remote-access tools, and never ask customers to open online banking during troubleshooting.
bait_tactics: Hang on, my laptop takes ages to boot up after an update—which error message did you say my modem was sending through?
I'm only on a mobile handset right now and don't have a computer in front of me, can you post out a letter explaining the line fault?
The wireless network in this part of the house keeps dropping out, could you walk me through what the issue is without installing anything?

scams.name: Urgent Family or Friend New-Number Scam
scams.name_en: Impersonated Family Emergency Money Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: transfer money urgently to this account
pay this invoice for me right now

scams.signals_en: Callers pose as a close family member or friend calling from an unfamiliar number, claiming their phone was broken or lost and they are in an urgent bind or accident.
scams.legit_en: Real relatives with a broken phone can still confirm shared family details or wait while you ring their original number or check with another family member on a separate channel.
bait_tactics: Oh goodness, the line sounds really muffled—which cousin is this again, and what happened to your usual number?
I don't have banking set up on this handset, let me quickly ring your old phone or check with the rest of the family first.
Slow down a bit so I can catch what happened—whereabouts are you right now, and why is it a different bank account?

MX.name: Mexico
MX.prevalence_note: CONDUSEF and local police 2025-2026: fake bank security asking to move money to a 'bóveda segura', virtual kidnapping and crossed-call extortion, and fake customs parcel fines dominate.

scams.name: Falso banco: bóveda segura / cuenta de resguardo
scams.name_en: Fake bank security moving money to a 'safe vault' or holding account
scams.signals_en: Poses as the bank's fraud area about unrecognized charges and asks to move the balance to a 'bóveda segura' or holding account, to read out the NIP or CVV, or to make a cardless withdrawal.
scams.legit_en: Real Mexican banks may confirm a purchase but never ask to move money to another account, read out the NIP or CVV, or make cardless withdrawals.
bait_tactics: Mostrarse preocupado y pedir que le expliquen despacio qué cargos son mientras busca el estado de cuenta
Decir que la tarjeta está en otra bolsa y preguntar con calma cómo funciona la bóveda segura

scams.name: Secuestro virtual / llamada cruzada
scams.name_en: Virtual kidnapping or crossed-call extortion over a relative
scams.signals_en: Claims a relative is held or in danger, keeps the owner on the line, tells them to switch off their phone or not tell anyone, and demands an urgent Oxxo deposit or SPEI transfer.
scams.legit_en: Real family emergencies can be checked by calling the relative; police and hospitals never ask for Oxxo deposits or SPEI transfers.
bait_tactics: Sonar asustado y pedir que repitan despacio el nombre y la ropa del familiar
Decir que no sabe hacer depósitos y preguntar paso por paso cómo se hace

scams.name: Falso SAT: adeudo fiscal y orden de aprehensión
scams.name_en: Fake tax office (SAT) call threatening an arrest warrant over a tax debt
scams.signals_en: Poses as the SAT saying the owner has a tax debt and an arrest warrant will be issued unless they pay today with gift cards, a deposit or a transfer.
scams.legit_en: The real SAT writes through its tax mailbox and never threatens arrest on the phone or takes gift cards or deposits.
bait_tactics: Preguntar despacio de qué año es el adeudo mientras busca sus papeles
Decir que no sabe dónde se compran esas tarjetas y pedir que se lo expliquen paso por paso

scams.name: Falsa aduana: paquete detenido con multa
scams.name_en: Fake customs call about a held parcel and a customs fine
scams.signals_en: Poses as customs or a courier saying a parcel is held and a customs fine or tax must be deposited today through a payment link.
scams.legit_en: Real couriers charge import duties through their own site or on delivery for parcels the owner expects, without fines by phone.
bait_tactics: Preguntar despacio qué hay en el paquete y quién lo manda
Decir que tiene que buscar el número de guía y pedir que expliquen otra vez cómo se calcula la multa

AR.name: Argentina
AR.prevalence_note: Argentine prosecutors' cybercrime unit 2024-2026: fake Mercado Pago or bank security asking to pass the CBU or change the alias, 'cuento del tío' relatives and old-dollar exchanges, and fake ANSES benefits dominate.

scams.name: Falso soporte de Mercado Pago / banco (CBU, alias)
scams.name_en: Fake Mercado Pago or bank security asking to pass the CBU or change the alias
scams.signals_en: Poses as Mercado Pago or the bank's security area about an unknown purchase, asks to pass the CBU, change the alias, share the screen or read out a security code.
scams.legit_en: Real Mercado Pago or bank support never asks to pass the CBU, change the alias, share the screen or read out codes.
bait_tactics: Decir que no encuentra dónde está el CBU en la aplicación y pedir que se lo expliquen despacio
Preguntar con calma qué compra es y de qué día mientras busca el resumen

scams.name: Cuento del tío: dólares cara chica fuera de circulación
scams.name_en: Fake relative or bank clerk collecting 'old' small-face dollars
scams.signals_en: Plays a relative or a bank clerk saying old small-face dollars go out of circulation and must be handed over or exchanged, then sends someone to the house to collect cash.
scams.legit_en: Banks never send people to the house to collect cash or exchange old notes; old US dollars stay valid.
bait_tactics: Mostrarse interesado y preguntar despacio cómo se distinguen los billetes cara chica
Decir que la plata está guardada en otro lado y preguntar cómo es el trámite paso por paso

scams.name: Falso bono de ANSES (clave de homebanking)
scams.name_en: Fake ANSES benefit asking for the home-banking password
scams.signals_en: Poses as ANSES about an extra bonus or refund for retirees and asks for the home-banking password, a token or a trip to the ATM to 'activate' it.
scams.legit_en: Real ANSES benefits are paid without calls asking for passwords, tokens or ATM steps.
bait_tactics: Preguntar despacio cuánto es el bono y cuándo se cobra
Decir que la clave la tiene anotada en un cuaderno que no encuentra y pedir que expliquen otra vez el trámite

scams.name: Robo de cuenta de mensajería con código de verificación
scams.name_en: Messaging Verification Code Account Takeover Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: pasame el código de seis números
código que te llegó por mensaje
confirmar el turno con el código

scams.signals_en: Impersonating public health offices, parcel couriers, or customer support, callers claim they need to confirm an appointment or delivery by asking the recipient to read aloud a six-digit SMS code just sent to their phone, enabling immediate messaging.
scams.legit_en: Public agencies, health clinics, postal services, and companies in Argentina and Uruguay never ask citizens to read out SMS verification codes during a phone call, as registration codes belong exclusively to the user.
bait_tactics: Todavía no me entró ningún mensajito de texto, acá en el fondo del departamento casi no agarra señal.
Pará que no tengo los anteojos de leer a mano y veo toda borrosa la pantalla del celular.
Disculpá, se me tildó la pantalla mientras hablábamos con el altavoz, dame un segundito.

scams.name: Estafa de falsas plataformas de inversión con rendimientos garantizados
scams.name_en: Fraudulent High-Yield Investment Advisory Call Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: abonar tasa o impuesto para retirar

scams.signals_en: After luring users through online advertisements impersonating financial institutions or public figures, fake advisors phone victims promising fast, guaranteed returns.
scams.legit_en: Authorized financial intermediaries registered with national securities regulators in Argentina and Uruguay never guarantee fixed high returns via cold calls, nor do they demand separate upfront fee transfers into third-party accounts to release client funds.
bait_tactics: Pará que anoto el número de matrícula para buscarlo en el registro de valores, ¿me lo decís despacio?
Justo se me estaba hirviendo el agua para el mate en la cocina, dame un segundo que apago la hornalla.
La computadora del estudio tarda un montón en arrancar, así que todavía no me abre la página.

AT.name: Austria
AT.prevalence_note: Watchlist Internet and police 2025-2026: fake bank calls about expiring ID Austria certificates asking for the Verfügernummer and app approval, fake police collecting gold and cash, and fake post or customs fees dominate.

scams.name: ID Austria / Bankanruf (Verfügernummer, Freigabe)
scams.name_en: Fake bank call about ID Austria asking for the Verfügernummer and an app approval
scams.signals_en: Poses as the bank's security team about an expiring ID Austria certificate, asks for the Verfügernummer, an approval in the banking app or a move to a 'Sicherheitskonto'.
scams.legit_en: Real Austrian banks never ask for the Verfügernummer, approvals in the app or moving money by phone.
bait_tactics: Verwirrt fragen, wo man die Verfügernummer überhaupt findet, und sich alles langsam erklären lassen
Sagen, dass das Handy gerade lädt, und nachfragen, was genau mit dem Zertifikat passiert

scams.name: Falsche Polizisten / Unfall-Kaution
scams.name_en: Fake police or relative-crash call collecting gold or cash
scams.signals_en: Fake officers say burglars or a relative's crash put the owner's savings at risk, ask to keep silent and hand cash, gold coins or valuables to a messenger.
scams.legit_en: Real Austrian police never collect cash, gold or valuables and never ask people to keep silent toward their family.
bait_tactics: Erschrocken klingen und langsam nach dem Namen des Beamten und der Dienststelle fragen
Sagen, dass der Schlüssel zum Kasten gerade nicht auffindbar ist, und fragen, wie die Übergabe genau ablaufen soll

scams.name: Falsche Kriminalpolizei: Sicherheitsverwahrung
scams.name_en: Fake criminal police taking valuables into safekeeping
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the criminal police says a relative is arrested or burglars are near and asks for bail at once or for cash and jewellery to be handed to a plain-clothes officer for safekeeping.
scams.legit_en: Austrian police never collect bail, cash or jewellery at the door.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass man sich erst hinsetzen muss, und bitten, alles noch einmal langsam zu erklären
Fragen, wann der Kollege vorbeikommen will

scams.name: Falsches Finanzamt: ID Austria Freigabe
scams.name_en: Fake tax office asking for an ID Austria approval
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from the tax office says a tax credit expires today and asks for login details or to approve a request in ID Austria.
scams.legit_en: The tax office never asks for ID Austria approvals or login details by phone.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass die Brille im Auto liegt, und fragen, um welches Jahr es geht
Fragen, wie hoch die Gutschrift sein soll

scams.name: Falsche Bank: TAN vorlesen oder Freigabe bestätigen
scams.name_en: Fake bank asking to read out a TAN or confirm an approval
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security team reports a suspicious payment and asks to read out the TAN code or confirm an approval in the banking app to stop it.
scams.legit_en: Austrian banks never ask customers to read out TAN codes or confirm approvals to stop a payment.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass die Banking-App gerade lädt, und bitten, es noch einmal zu erklären
Fragen, welche Zahlung es war und an welchem Tag

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.prevalence_note: Swiss Crime Prevention and cantonal police 2025-2026: fake police shock calls collecting valuables, TWINT or e-banking approval scams, and spoofed fedpol robocalls dominate.

scams.name: Falsche Polizisten / Schockanruf (Wertsachen)
scams.name_en: Fake police shock call collecting valuables
scams.signals_en: Fake cantonal police say a relative caused a serious accident or burglars target the owner, demand strict secrecy and send a courier for cash or valuables.
scams.legit_en: Real Swiss police never collect cash or valuables at the door and never ask people to keep it secret from their family.
bait_tactics: Besorgt klingen und langsam nach Namen, Posten und Aktenzeichen fragen
Sagen, dass der Tresorschlüssel bei der Nachbarin ist, und fragen, wie der Kurier genau vorgeht

scams.name: TWINT / E-Banking Freigabe
scams.name_en: Fake support asking for a TWINT code or a payment approval
scams.signals_en: Poses as TWINT or bank support about a suspicious debit and asks the owner to read out a TWINT code, scan a QR code or approve a payment in the app.
scams.legit_en: Real TWINT and bank support never ask for codes, QR scans or payment approvals on the phone.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass die App gerade nicht aufgeht, und sich langsam erklären lassen, wo der Code steht
Nachfragen, welche Abbuchung genau gemeint ist und von welchem Tag

scams.name: Falscher fedpol-Anruf
scams.name_en: Spoofed fedpol or federal prosecutor robocall
scams.signals_en: A recorded voice or fake officer from fedpol says the owner's identity was misused and they must pay or transfer money to avoid a criminal complaint.
scams.legit_en: Real federal authorities write letters and never demand payments or transfers on the phone.
bait_tactics: Verwirrt nachfragen, welches Verfahren gemeint ist, und sich alles langsam erklären lassen
Sagen, dass man erst die Brille holen muss, und um die Aktennummer bitten

scams.name: Falscher technischer Support
scams.name_en: Fake technical support
scams.signals_en: A caller from a software company says the computer is infected and asks to install AnyDesk or open TeamViewer, then to log in to e-banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses and never ask to control a computer or watch e-banking.
bait_tactics: Sagen, dass der Computer sehr langsam startet, und fragen, was auf dem Bildschirm stehen soll
Fragen, welche Fehlermeldung sie bekommen haben

RU.name: Russia
RU.prevalence_note: Bank of Russia and police warnings 2025-2026: fake Central Bank, FSB or bank security staff moving savings to a safe account, and fake operator staff asking for SMS codes to extend a SIM contract dominate.

scams.name: Лжесотрудники ЦБ или ФСБ и «безопасный счёт»
scams.name_en: Fake Central Bank or FSB officer moving savings to a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the FSB, the Central Bank or a bank's security service says someone is taking a loan in the owner's name and the savings must go to a safe account or a counter loan must be taken.
scams.legit_en: The Central Bank has no private clients, and no bank or police officer asks anyone to move money to another account on the phone.
bait_tactics: Встревоженно переспрашивать, какой именно кредит оформляют и в каком отделении
Говорить, что очки остались в прихожей, и просить продиктовать всё помедленнее

scams.name: Продление договора связи по коду из СМС
scams.name_en: Fake mobile operator extending a SIM contract for an SMS code
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the mobile operator or Gosuslugi says the SIM contract or account is about to expire and asks for the code that just arrived by SMS.
scams.legit_en: Operators extend contracts without calls, and real staff never ask for a code from an SMS.
bait_tactics: Говорить, что СМС приходят на старый кнопочный телефон в другой комнате, и долго его искать
Переспрашивать, какой у договора номер и с какого года он заключён

TR.name: Turkey
TR.prevalence_note: Police and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake police or prosecutors linking the owner to terrorism and moving money to a state account, and fake bank staff refunding card fees for an SMS code dominate.

scams.name: Sahte polis ve savcı: devlet güvence hesabı
scams.name_en: Fake police or prosecutor moving money to a state safe account
scams.signals_en: Fake counter-terrorism police or a prosecutor say the owner's name came up in a terror or money-laundering case and the money must go to a state account or be handed to a plain-clothes officer.
scams.legit_en: Turkish police and prosecutors never ask for transfers, cash or gold on the phone.
bait_tactics: Endişeli görünüp hangi dosyadan bahsettiklerini yavaşça sormak
Yakın gözlüğünü bulamadığını söyleyip her şeyi tekrar ettirmek

scams.name: Kart aidatı iadesi bahanesiyle şifre
scams.name_en: Fake bank refunding card fees for an SMS code
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's head office offers to refund past card fees or stop a suspicious charge and asks for the SMS code or a transfer to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks refund fees without calls and never ask for SMS codes or transfers on the phone.
bait_tactics: Mobil bankacılık uygulamasının güncelleme istediğini söyleyip beklemek
Hangi kartın aidatından bahsettiklerini ve tutarı yavaşça sormak

VN.name: Vietnam
VN.prevalence_note: Ministry of Public Security warnings 2025-2026: fake police moving money to a holding account during a secret investigation, and fake EVN staff installing an app and reading a Smart OTP dominate.

scams.name: Giả công an: chuyển tiền vào tài khoản tạm giữ
scams.name_en: Fake police moving money to a holding account
scams.signals_en: Fake ward police or prosecutors say the owner is linked to money laundering, demand secrecy and order the money moved to a holding account for checking.
scams.legit_en: Vietnamese police never handle cases by phone or ask for transfers to any account.
bait_tactics: Tỏ ra lo lắng, hỏi chậm rãi đó là vụ việc nào và ở phường nào
Nói kính lão để trên lầu, nhờ đọc lại từng chữ

scams.name: Giả điện lực: cài ứng dụng và đọc Smart OTP
scams.name_en: Fake EVN staff installing an app and reading a Smart OTP
scams.signals_en: Fake EVN staff threaten to cut the power within hours and ask the owner to install an app from a link and read out a Smart OTP.
scams.legit_en: EVN sends notices on paper or in its official app and never asks for OTP codes on the phone.
bait_tactics: Nói điện thoại cũ đầy bộ nhớ, tải mãi không xong
Hỏi tháng nào chưa đóng tiền và số tiền bao nhiêu
sources: Tập đoàn Điện lực Việt Nam

TH.name: Thailand
TH.prevalence_note: Royal Thai Police and PEA/MEA warnings 2025-2026: call-center gangs posing as police asking for a LINE video statement and a transfer to check the money, and fake electricity staff installing an app to refund the meter deposit dominate.

scams.name: แก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์อ้างเป็นตำรวจ ให้โอนเงินมาตรวจสอบ
scams.name_en: Fake police taking a LINE statement and a transfer to check the money

red_flag_keywords.text: โอนเงินมาตรวจสอบ
แอดไลน์สอบปากคำ

scams.signals_en: Fake police or DSI officers say the owner's account is tied to money laundering, take a statement over a LINE video call and ask for a transfer to prove the money is clean.
scams.legit_en: Thai police never take statements on LINE or ask for transfers to check money.
bait_tactics: ทำเป็นกังวล ถามช้าๆ ว่าเป็นคดีอะไร ที่สถานีไหน
บอกว่าหาแว่นสายตาไม่เจอ ขอให้พูดซ้ำทีละคำ
sources: สำนักงานตำรวจแห่งชาติ

scams.name: อ้างการไฟฟ้าคืนเงินประกันมิเตอร์ ให้โหลดแอป
scams.name_en: Fake electricity staff refunding the meter deposit through an app
context_keywords: คืนเงินประกันมิเตอร์

red_flag_keywords.text: กดลิงก์โหลดแอปการไฟฟ้า
โหลดแอปการไฟฟ้าจากลิงก์
ติดตั้งไฟล์ apk

scams.signals_en: Fake PEA or MEA staff offer to refund the meter deposit and ask the owner to install an app from a link, set a code and scan their face.
scams.legit_en: The electricity authorities refund deposits through their official channels and never send app links by LINE.
bait_tactics: บอกว่าเน็ตมือถือหมุนติ้วๆ โหลดไม่ขึ้น
ถามว่ามิเตอร์ไหนและจะได้คืนเท่าไหร่
sources: การไฟฟ้าส่วนภูมิภาค

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.prevalence_note: SAMA and Absher warnings 2025-2026: fake Absher staff asking the owner to pick the number shown in Nafath, and fake central bank staff moving money to a temporary protection account dominate.

scams.name: انتحال أبشر وطلب الرقم الظاهر في نفاذ
scams.name_en: Fake Absher staff asking for the Nafath number or code
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as Absher or a government platform says the account will be suspended and asks the owner to accept the number shown in Nafath or read out the code.
scams.legit_en: Government platforms never call to ask for Nafath numbers or verification codes.
bait_tactics: يقول إن التطبيق يحمّل ببطء ويطلب منه الانتظار
يسأل بهدوء عن أي خدمة يتكلم ومتى ستتوقف

scams.name: انتحال البنك المركزي وتحويل الرصيد لحساب حماية
scams.name_en: Fake central bank moving money to a temporary protection account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the central bank or the owner's bank says the account is frozen and the balance must be moved to a temporary protection account.
scams.legit_en: Banks and SAMA never ask customers to move their money to another account on the phone.
bait_tactics: يقول إن البطاقة في السيارة ويروح يجيبها
يسأل عن اسم الفرع ورقم البلاغ بهدوء

scams.name: انتحال صفة الشرطة أو الجهات الأمنية والمالية
scams.name_en: Police and Financial Authority Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from criminal investigations or financial crime police, alleging suspicious transfers on the resident's bank account.
scams.legit_en: Police departments across Gulf states repeatedly confirm that officers never call individuals to ask for bank card details, verification codes, or money transfers; official inquiries take place through formal police channels.
bait_tactics: الصوت غير واضح بسبب التكييف عندي، هل يمكنك إعادة اسم الإدارة ورقم البلاغ ببطء حتى أكتبه؟
أبحث الآن عن ورقة وقلم لتدوين المعلومات، لكن الهاتف الآخر يرن في نفس الوقت، ثانية واحدة معك.
لم تصلني أي إشعارات رسمية على هاتفي، هل يمكنك توضيح تاريخ المعاملة التي تتحدث عنها بالضبط؟

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.prevalence_note: Dubai Police and UAE Central Bank warnings 2025-2026: fake police demanding a fine paid through an exchange house, and fake Emirates Post delivery fees paid through a link dominate.

scams.name: انتحال الشرطة وطلب غرامة عن طريق الصرافة
scams.name_en: Fake police demanding a fine through an exchange house
scams.signals_en: Fake police say the owner faces a money-laundering or residency case and must pay a fine at once through an exchange house or a link.
scams.legit_en: UAE police never collect fines on the phone or through exchange houses.
bait_tactics: يتظاهر بالقلق ويسأل بهدوء عن رقم القضية ومتى سُجلت
يقول إن الصرافة القريبة مقفلة ويسأل عن غيرها

scams.name: رسوم توصيل وهمية عبر رابط
scams.name_en: Fake delivery or customs fee paid through a link
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as Emirates Post or a courier says a parcel is held and asks the owner to pay a small fee and enter card details through a link.
scams.legit_en: Couriers do not call to collect fees through links, and customs fees are paid on official sites.
bait_tactics: يقول إن الرابط ما يفتح ويطلب منهم يشرحون مرة ثانية
يسأل عن رقم الشحنة ومن أين أُرسلت

scams.name: انتحال منصات الهوية الرقمية وطلب رمز التحقق
scams.name_en: Digital Identity App and OTP Verification Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to represent a government portal or telecom regulator, warning that the resident's national ID, residency file, or SIM registration will be suspended today.
scams.legit_en: Government portals, central banks, and telecom operators across Gulf states never ask residents to read one-time verification codes over the phone or approve unsolicited login requests inside digital identity applications.
bait_tactics: الشبكة عندي ضعيفة حالياً داخل المبنى ولم تصلني أي رسالة نصية، هل يمكنك الانتظار قليلاً حتى أتحرك لمكان فيه تغطية؟
التطبيق يطلب تحديثاً جديداً على الجوال والتحميل بطيء جداً، ما اسم القسم الرسمي الذي تتصل منه بالضبط؟
الشاشة علقت عندي وأنا أحاول فتح الإشعارات، أعد لي رقم المعاملة ببطء لو سمحت ريثما يفتح الجهاز.

scams.name: انتحال موظف البنك لتحديث الحساب وتجميد البطاقة
scams.name_en: Bank Account Freeze and KYC Update Call Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as bank customer support or central bank compliance staff, the caller warns that the victim's bank account and debit card are about to be frozen due to an expired ID record.
scams.legit_en: Banks and central banks across GCC countries require customers to update expired identification only in branch or directly inside verified official banking apps, and never request CVV numbers or OTP codes by phone.
bait_tactics: محفظتي في الغرفة الثانية ولا أحفظ أرقام البطاقة عن ظهر قلب، انتظر لحظة أبحث عنها ولكن الخط يقطع قليلاً.
لدي أكثر من حساب بنكي ولا أعرف أي بطاقة تقصدون، هل تذكر لي الفرع المسجل لديكم أولاً؟
حاولت فتح تطبيق البنك للتأكد لكن يظهر لي خطأ في الاتصال بالإنترنت، أمهلني دقيقة أعيد تشغيل الشبكة.

EG.name: Egypt
EG.prevalence_note: Central Bank of Egypt warnings 2025-2026: fake bank or InstaPay staff asking for the card's back digits and a test transfer, and fake Vodafone Cash prizes with an activation fee dominate.

scams.name: انتحال البنك وإنستاباي وطلب أرقام ضهر الكارت
scams.name_en: Fake bank or InstaPay staff asking for the card's back digits
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank or InstaPay says the account will be closed unless the owner reads the digits on the back of the card or makes a test transfer.
scams.legit_en: Egyptian banks never ask for card digits, codes or test transfers on the phone.
bait_tactics: يقول إن الكارت في المحفظة في العربية ويروح يجيبه
يسأل بهدوء أنهي حساب وإمتى هيتقفل

scams.name: جايزة فودافون كاش ورسوم تشغيلها
scams.name_en: Fake Vodafone Cash prize with an activation fee
scams.signals_en: A caller congratulates the owner on a Vodafone Cash prize and asks for a fee or the wallet code to release it.
scams.legit_en: Real prizes are never released for a fee or a wallet code.
bait_tactics: يسأل الجايزة قد إيه وهتوصل إزاي
يقول إن الموبايل التاني اللي عليه المحفظة مش معاه

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.prevalence_note: Fraudehelpdesk and police warnings 2025-2026: fake bank helpdesk staff moving money to a vault account, and fake police collecting valuables and PIN codes at the door dominate.

scams.name: Bankhelpdeskfraude: geld naar een kluisrekening
scams.name_en: Fake bank helpdesk moving money to a vault account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's fraud department reports a suspicious login and asks the owner to move the money to a vault or safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask customers to move money to another account to keep it safe.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de bankapp nog aan het laden is en rustig laten uitleggen wat er precies is gebeurd
Vragen welke transactie het was en op welke dag

scams.name: Nepagenten halen waardevolle spullen op
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting valuables and PIN codes
scams.signals_en: Fake police say burglars have the owner's address and a colleague will come to secure valuables and bank cards, and ask for the PIN code.
scams.legit_en: Dutch police never collect valuables or bank cards at the door and never ask for PIN codes.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de sleutel van de kast bij de buurvrouw ligt
Rustig vragen hoe de collega eruitziet en hoe laat hij komt

scams.name: Helpdeskfraude: meekijken op uw computer
scams.name_en: Fake helpdesk watching the computer
scams.signals_en: A caller from a helpdesk says the computer has a virus and asks to install AnyDesk or TeamViewer so they can watch while the owner logs in to online banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies and banks never ask to watch while a customer logs in to online banking.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de computer heel traag opstart en vragen wat er op het scherm moet staan
Vragen welke foutmelding ze hebben gekregen

PL.name: Poland
PL.prevalence_note: Police and CERT Polska warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security staff moving money to a technical account, and fake CBŚP officers collecting cash during a secret action dominate.

scams.name: Fałszywy pracownik banku: konto techniczne
scams.name_en: Fake bank security moving money to a technical account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department says someone is applying for a loan in the owner's name and the money must go to a technical or safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks never ask customers to move money to a technical account on the phone.
bait_tactics: Mówić, że aplikacja banku się aktualizuje, i prosić o powolne tłumaczenie
Pytać spokojnie, o jaki wniosek chodzi i z którego dnia

scams.name: Na policjanta: tajna akcja i zabezpieczenie gotówki
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting cash during a secret action
scams.signals_en: Fake police or CBŚP officers say a gang works inside the owner's bank, impose investigation secrecy and ask for the cash to be secured by a courier.
scams.legit_en: Polish police never collect money and never ask people to keep it from their family.
bait_tactics: Udawać zaniepokojenie i powoli dopytywać, o jaką akcję chodzi
Mówić, że okulary zostały w kuchni, i prosić o powtórzenie

scams.name: Fałszywy ZUS: dodatek i opłata weryfikacyjna
scams.name_en: Fake social insurance allowance with a verification fee
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as ZUS or another office says the owner is entitled to an allowance and asks for a small verification fee or bank login details.
scams.legit_en: ZUS never asks for fees or bank login details to pay an allowance.
bait_tactics: Powiedzieć, że trzeba znaleźć okulary, i zapytać, o jaki dodatek chodzi
Zapytać, ile ma wynosić ten dodatek

RO.name: Romania
RO.prevalence_note: Romanian Police and DNSC warnings 2025-2026: spoofed bank or police calls pushing a cancellation loan or a new account, the accident method with a courier collecting cash, and fake tax inspectors.

scams.name: Fals angajat al băncii sau al BNR: credit de anulare
scams.name_en: Fake bank or central bank staff pushing a cancellation loan
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as bank anti-fraud staff, the central bank or the police says a loan was taken in the owner's name and a cancellation loan or a move to a new account is needed.
scams.legit_en: Banks and the central bank never ask customers to take a loan or move their money to another account over the phone.
bait_tactics: Spune că aplicația băncii se actualizează și roagă-l să explice încă o dată, rar
Întreabă liniștit de ce zi este cererea de credit și pentru ce sumă

scams.name: Metoda accidentul: rudă implicată într-un accident
scams.name_en: Relative in a car accident, cash collected by a courier
context_keywords: a lovit pe cineva cu mașina

red_flag_keywords.text: vine un curier să ia banii

scams.signals_en: A fake lawyer, police officer or doctor says a relative caused a serious accident and a courier will come for cash to settle it amicably.
scams.legit_en: Police and lawyers never send couriers to collect cash for a relative in trouble.
bait_tactics: Fă-te îngrijorat și întreabă încet ce s-a întâmplat exact și unde
Spune că trebuie să găsești ochelarii ca să notezi adresa

scams.name: Fals inspector ANAF: poprire pe cont și plată imediată
scams.name_en: Fake tax inspector demanding payment to lift an account freeze
scams.signals_en: A fake tax inspector says the account is frozen for tax debts and will be unblocked once a payment is made through a link.
scams.legit_en: The tax office does not call to take payments through links or messaging apps.
bait_tactics: Întreabă rar pentru ce an este datoria
Spune că nu găsești plicul de la ANAF și roagă-l să aștepte

scams.name: Broker fals: câștig rapid garantat
scams.name_en: Fake broker promising quick guaranteed gains
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a broker promises guaranteed quick gains, asks to install AnyDesk and later demands a withdrawal fee to release the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never promise guaranteed gains or charge fees to release money.
bait_tactics: Spune că își notează și întreabă cât e prima depunere
Întreabă cât durează o retragere

MD.name: Moldova
MD.prevalence_note: Moldovan police warnings 2025-2026: the relative-in-an-accident scheme with cash collected in person, and fake bank staff calling about loans.

bait_tactics: Fă-te îngrijorat și întreabă încet ce s-a întâmplat exact și unde

scams.name_en: Fake bank or central bank staff pushing a cancellation loan

scams.legit_en: Banks and the central bank never ask customers to take a loan or move their money to another account over the phone.

scams.name_en: Spoofed bank or police call about a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank, the police or a cybersecurity agency says a loan was taken in the owner's name and asks for the PIN or CVV, a remote access app or a transfer to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks and the police never ask for PIN or CVV codes or transfers to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Spune că aplicația băncii se încarcă și roagă-l să explice încă o dată
Întreabă de ce zi este creditul
