SE.prevalence_note: Polisen and PTS warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for Mobilt BankID or bankdosa codes, fake police collecting cards and jewellery, telecom contract tricks signed with BankID, and investment scams.

scams.name: Falsk säkerhetsavdelning: BankID och bankdosa
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for BankID or bankdosa codes
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department warns of a loan or card payment the owner did not make and asks to sign in with Mobilt BankID, read codes from the bankdosa or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Swedish banks never call and ask customers to sign in with BankID, read bankdosa codes or move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Säga att mobilen just startar om och be dem förklara en gång till, lugnt
Fråga vilken dag lånet ska ha tagits och på hur mycket

scams.name: Falska poliser hämtar kort och smycken
scams.name_en: Fake police collecting bank cards and jewellery
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a police officer says burglars or identity thieves target the owner, asks for BankID verification and says plain-clothes staff will come to collect bank cards, codes, gold and jewellery.
scams.legit_en: The Swedish police never ask people to verify themselves with BankID by phone or collect cards, codes or valuables at home.
bait_tactics: Säga att nycklarna till skåpet ligger hos grannen och fråga när de tänkte komma
Fråga lugnt hur personen som kommer ser ut

scams.name: Falsk mobiloperatör: signera med BankID direkt
scams.name_en: Fake mobile operator pushing a BankID signature
scams.signals_en: A caller from a mobile operator promises a lower monthly cost or a network update and pushes the owner to sign a contract with BankID at once or lose the number today.
scams.legit_en: Operators do not shut numbers off the same day and never require a BankID signature during a cold call.
bait_tactics: Säga att glasögonen ligger i bilen och be dem läsa upp villkoren igen
Fråga vad det kostar efter första året

scams.name: Investeringsbedrägeri med krypto
scams.name_en: Crypto investment scam

red_flag_keywords.text: avgift för att få ut vinsten

scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a financial adviser promises returns on crypto, asks to install a remote-control program and later demands a tax or fee to pay out the profit.
scams.legit_en: Licensed advisers never ask clients to install remote-control programs or pay a fee to get their profit out.
bait_tactics: Säga att man skriver upp allt och fråga hur mycket man ska börja med
Fråga hur lång tid en utbetalning tar

NO.name: Norway
NO.prevalence_note: Politiet and Økokrim warnings 2025-2026: fake bank or police staff asking for BankID passwords and one-time codes (the 'Olga' method), fake Microsoft support, fake Skatteetaten refunds and investment scams.

scams.name: BankID-svindel: falsk bank eller politi
scams.name_en: BankID fraud by fake bank or police staff
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department, the police or Økokrim speaks of a suspicious loan and asks for the BankID password and one-time code, an approval in the BankID app or a transfer to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Banks and the police never ask for BankID passwords or codes and never move money to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Si at telefonen holder på å starte på nytt og be dem forklare en gang til, rolig
Spørre hvilken dag lånet skal være tatt opp og hvor mye

scams.name: Falsk Microsoft-support: fjerntilgang
scams.name_en: Fake Microsoft support with remote access
scams.signals_en: A caller from Microsoft or an IT company says the computer has a virus or a licence problem and asks for remote access and to log in to online banking while they watch.
scams.legit_en: Microsoft never calls about viruses or licences and never asks to watch online banking.
bait_tactics: Si at PC-en starter veldig sakte og spørre hva som skal stå på skjermen
Spørre hvilken feilmelding de har fått

scams.name: Falsk Skatteetaten: penger til gode
scams.name_en: Fake tax office refund
scams.signals_en: A caller or text from Skatteetaten says the owner has money back and asks to click a link and confirm with BankID or give card number and security code for the payout.
scams.legit_en: Skatteetaten pays refunds to the registered account and never asks for card numbers or codes.
bait_tactics: Si at brillene ligger i bilen og spørre hvor mye det gjelder
Spørre hvilket år oppgjøret gjelder

scams.name: Investeringssvindel med krypto
scams.name_en: Crypto investment scam
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as a broker promises guaranteed returns on crypto or shares, asks for a starting deposit and remote access, then demands a fee to pay out the gain.
scams.legit_en: Licensed brokers never promise guaranteed returns or charge fees to release a gain.
bait_tactics: Si at man skriver ned alt og spørre hvor mye man må begynne med
Spørre hvor lang tid en utbetaling tar

DK.name: Denmark
DK.prevalence_note: Politiet and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for MitID approvals or a move to a security account, fake police or tax staff asking for card details, and fake technical support.

scams.name: Falsk bankrådgiver: godkend med MitID
scams.name_en: Fake bank adviser asking for a MitID approval
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks the owner to approve in MitID, give a code or move money to a security account.
scams.legit_en: Danish banks never ask customers to approve MitID requests they did not start or to move money to a security account.
bait_tactics: Sige at telefonen genstarter og bede dem forklare det en gang til, roligt
Spørge hvilken dag overførslen var og hvor stort beløbet var

scams.name: Falsk politi eller Skattestyrelsen: identitetsmisbrug
scams.name_en: Fake police or tax office about identity misuse
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police or the tax agency speaks of identity misuse or an investigation and asks for card details, the CPR number and a MitID approval.
scams.legit_en: The police and Skattestyrelsen never ask for card details or MitID approvals by phone.
bait_tactics: Sige at man lige skal finde brillerne og bede dem gentage det langsomt
Spørge hvornår misbruget skulle være sket

scams.name: Falsk teknisk support: overtage kontrollen
scams.name_en: Fake tech support taking control of the computer
scams.signals_en: A caller from a technical department says the computer has a security problem and asks to download a program so they can take control, then to log in to online banking.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about security problems and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sige at computeren starter meget langsomt og spørge hvad der skal stå på skærmen
Spørge hvilken fejlbesked de har fået

FI.name: Finland
FI.prevalence_note: Poliisi and Traficom warnings 2025-2026: fake bank security asking for bank credentials and moving money to a 'safe account', fake police or tax staff asking for online bank codes, and fake technical support.

scams.name: Valepankkivirkailija: pankkitunnukset ja turvatili
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking for credentials and a safe account
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports a suspicious transfer and asks for bank credentials, a confirmation code or a move of money to a safe account.
scams.legit_en: Finnish banks never ask for bank credentials or codes by phone and never move money to a safe account.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pankin sovellus päivittyy, ja pyytää selittämään uudestaan rauhassa
Kysyä, minä päivänä siirto tehtiin ja kuinka suuri summa

scams.name: Valepoliisi tai -viranomainen: identiteettivarkaus
scams.name_en: Fake police or authority about identity theft
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the police, the tax office or Traficom speaks of identity theft or a criminal case and asks for online bank codes, card details or a password.
scams.legit_en: The police and other authorities never ask for online bank codes, card details or passwords by phone.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että pitää etsiä silmälasit, ja pyytää toistamaan hitaasti
Kysyä, milloin varkauden piti tapahtua

scams.name: Vale tekninen tuki: etähallintaohjelma
scams.name_en: Fake tech support with a remote-control program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a virus or a licence problem and asks to install a remote-control program and enter credit card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about viruses or licences and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Sanoa, että tietokone käynnistyy hitaasti, ja kysyä, mitä ruudulla pitäisi näkyä
Kysyä, minkä virheilmoituksen he saivat

IS.name: Iceland
IS.prevalence_note: Lögreglan and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank staff asking for an approval in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app, fake technical support with AnyDesk, and crypto investment calls.
IS.cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from abroad in English.

scams.name: Falskur bankastarfsmaður: samþykkja rafræn skilríki
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking to approve an e-ID request
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports an unusual payment and asks the owner to approve a request in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app or give a security number.
scams.legit_en: Icelandic banks never ask customers to approve an e-ID request they did not start or to give security numbers.
bait_tactics: Segja að síminn sé að endurræsa sig og biðja þá að útskýra aftur í rólegheitum
Spyrja hvaða dag greiðslan var og hversu há

scams.name: Fölsk tækniþjónusta: setja upp forrit
scams.name_en: Fake tech support installing a program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a problem or offers a refund and asks to install AnyDesk or a similar program and enter card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about refunds or viruses and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Segja að tölvan sé mjög lengi að ræsa sig og spyrja hvað eigi að sjást á skjánum
Spyrja hvaða villuboð þeir fengu

scams.name: Rafmyntasvik: óinnleyst inneign
scams.name_en: Crypto investment with unclaimed balance
scams.signals_en: A caller says the owner has an unclaimed crypto balance or a profitable investment and asks for card details or to log in to online banking to receive it.
scams.legit_en: No real exchange calls about unclaimed balances or asks for online banking access.
bait_tactics: Segja að maður skrifi allt niður og spyrja hversu há inneignin sé
Spyrja hvenær reikningurinn var stofnaður

SG.name: Singapore
SG.prevalence_note: Singapore 2025-2026 warnings: government Officials Impersonation Scam; fake Friend Lost Phone Urgent Transfer Scam; tech Support Compromised Device Remote Access Scam; investment Learning Community and Stock Mentor Scam.
SG.cross_border_note: Many calls come from abroad in English or Mandarin with spoofed local numbers.

scams.name: Government Officials Impersonation Scam
scams.name_en: Government Officials Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from a local bank, police force, or financial regulator, accusing the recipient of involvement in money laundering or identity misuse.
scams.legit_en: Singapore government officials never ask members of the public to transfer money over a phone call, disclose banking or national digital identity credentials, install unofficial apps, or transfer calls directly to police.
bait_tactics: Sorry ah, I'm on the underground train right now and the line keeps cutting off—can you repeat your department name slowly?
Hold on, my bank account has the money lock feature turned on so I cannot transfer anything by phone anyway; let me check at the branch later.
I don't have my identity card with me right now, maybe I call back through the official government hotline when I reach home?

scams.name: Fake Friend Call Scam
scams.name_en: Fake Friend Lost Phone Urgent Transfer Scam
scams.signals_en: An unknown caller warmly asks if the recipient recognizes their voice, claiming they lost their mobile phone and switched numbers.
scams.legit_en: Real friends, relatives, and business contacts should always be verified by calling their previously saved phone number directly or meeting in person, and they will not demand urgent transfers to unfamiliar third-party bank accounts.
bait_tactics: Wait ah, your voice sounds quite different today—which primary school or office did we know each other from?
My daily transfer limit is set super low and my token is at home, so I really cannot send anything right now.

scams.name: Tech Support Remote Access Scam
scams.name_en: Tech Support Compromised Device Remote Access Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as software or security helpdesk staff, the caller claims the recipient's computer or phone has been hacked or infected with malware.
scams.legit_en: Reputable technology companies and banks never make unsolicited calls offering virus removal, never ask users to install remote-control software, and never ask customers to approve banking token prompts during support calls.
bait_tactics: Oh, this laptop belongs to my company IT department and blocks all downloads without an administrator password.
My home broadband just dropped connection so the browser won't load anything—let me bring the device to the service centre tomorrow.
Why would fixing a computer virus need me to open my bank app? Wait ah, let me ask my nephew who works in IT first.

scams.name: Investment Chat Group Mentor Scam
scams.name_en: Investment Learning Community and Stock Mentor Scam
scams.signals_en: Following up on online ads or unsolicited outreach, the caller claims to represent a renowned university seminar or brokerage mentor group offering free stock tips.
scams.legit_en: Licensed financial institutions in Singapore are regulated on official directories, never guarantee risk-free investment returns over unsolicited calls or chat groups, and never ask clients to wire funds to personal accounts.
bait_tactics: Sounds interesting, can you give me your representative licence number first so I can look it up on the official regulator register?
I'm outside having lunch now and don't click links from unknown numbers—just mail your prospectus to my office.
All my savings are tied up in fixed deposits right now, so I have zero spare cash to open any new trading account.

MY.name: Malaysia
MY.prevalence_note: Malaysia 2025-2026 warnings: police, Tax Agency, and Court Warrant Impersonation Scam; communications Regulator Phone Line Suspension Scam; fake Bank Fraud Alert and Authorization Code Theft; courier Parcel Contraband and Identity Misuse Scam.
MY.cross_border_note: Calls in Malay, English or Mandarin, often from spoofed local numbers or from abroad.

scams.name: Penipuan Menyamar Pegawai Polis, Cukai dan Mahkamah
scams.name_en: Police, Tax Agency, and Court Warrant Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: Known locally as a Macau Scam, the caller poses as a court, tax board, or police officer alleging unpaid tax arrears, illegal company registration, or money laundering tied to the victim's identity card.
scams.legit_en: Malaysian courts, tax authorities, and Royal Malaysia Police never transfer phone calls between enforcement agencies, issue arrest warrants via messaging apps, or instruct citizens to transfer money or share banking credentials.
bait_tactics: Maaf tuan, garis telefon dekat kawasan perumahan saya ni tengah hujan lebat jadi putus-putus, boleh ulang nama jabatan perlahan sikit?
Saya memang bayar cukai potong gaji setiap bulan, kejap saya cari fail penyata dekat bilik belakang tapi kunci laci pula tak jumpa.
Kalau betul ada kes rasmi, biar saya pergi sendiri ke balai polis berdekatan petang nanti untuk semak laporan.

scams.name: Penipuan Sekatan Talian Telefon Menyamar Pengawal Selia
scams.name_en: Communications Regulator Phone Line Suspension Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to represent the national communications regulator or ministry, warning that all mobile numbers registered under the recipient's identity card will be terminated within hours due to spam complaints or unpaid bills.
scams.legit_en: Malaysia's communications ministry and telecommunications regulator never call individual subscribers to shut down phone lines, collect overdue bills, or transfer calls to police, as billing and account matters are handled solely by telecom operators.
bait_tactics: Pelik juga sebab bil telefon saya memang potong automatik setiap bulan, nanti saya semak sendiri dalam aplikasi mudah alih saya.
Sekarang saya tengah memandu di lebuh raya, memang tak boleh salin apa-apa nombor rujukan, hantar surat rasmi ke alamat bil sajalah.
Talian ni elok saja saya tengah guna bercakap sekarang, petang nanti saya singgah pusat khidmat pelanggan tanya sendiri.

scams.name: Penipuan Amaran Transaksi Kad Bank dan Kod Pengesahan
scams.name_en: Fake Bank Fraud Alert and Authorization Code Theft
scams.signals_en: Impersonating a bank security unit or central bank officer, the caller alerts the recipient to a large overseas card charge or unauthorized transfer.
scams.legit_en: Malaysian commercial banks and the central bank only follow up on customer-initiated fraud reports and never make unsolicited calls asking customers to read out banking usernames, passwords, card PINs, or transaction authorization codes.
bait_tactics: Kad bank tu ada dalam dompet saya sekarang dan saya langsung tak pernah aktifkan transaksi luar negara pun.
Kejap ya, saya letak telefon dulu dan terus hubungi sendiri nombor rasmi di belakang kad bank saya untuk sahkan.
Telefon saya ni tak keluar apa-apa mesej pengesahan pun sebab liputan dalam bangunan pejabat ni sangat lemah.

scams.name: Penipuan Bungkusan Kurier Mengandungi Barang Terlarang
scams.name_en: Courier Parcel Contraband and Identity Misuse Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller poses as a courier representative claiming a parcel sent under the recipient's name and identity number was intercepted containing illicit bank cards, passports, or contraband.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate courier and postal operators in Malaysia issue standard tracking numbers for lookup on official websites, never investigate criminal contraband over unsolicited calls, never request personal banking details, and never route customer calls.
bait_tactics: Saya memang tak pernah kirim bungkusan ke negeri itu, bagi nombor jejak bungkusan biar saya semak sendiri dekat laman rasmi.
Sekarang saya tengah sibuk di tempat kerja, kalau bungkusan tu bukan nama alamat rumah saya, pulangkan saja kepada pengirim asal.
Tak perlu sambungkan talian ke mana-mana, saya boleh jalan kaki buat semakan sendiri dekat kaunter cawangan lepas waktu pejabat.

PH.name: Philippines
PH.prevalence_note: Philippines 2025-2026 warnings: bank Account and Credit Card OTP Vishing; fake Telecom Regulator and SIM Deactivation Vishing; part-Time Online Task and Advance Deposit Scam.
PH.cross_border_note: Calls in English or Tagalog, often with texts sent first.

scams.name: Bank Verification and Credit Card Upgrade OTP Vishing
scams.name_en: Bank Account and Credit Card OTP Vishing
scams.signals_en: Callers address the recipient by name while posing as bank fraud officers or credit card agents offering a free limit upgrade, points conversion, or urgent account verification.
scams.legit_en: Philippine banks and the central bank remind consumers that official representatives never send clickable text links and never ask customers for passwords, card security numbers, or one-time PINs during phone calls.
bait_tactics: Hold on for a second, the electric fan right beside me is pretty loud so I missed that part, could you repeat which department you're calling from?
Wait a bit, I left my reading glasses in the bedroom so I can't read any small messages on my phone screen right now.
Our home internet has been super slow since this morning, could you spell out the reference code again while I look for a notepad?

scams.name: Fake Telecommunications Regulator SIM Suspension Call
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Regulator and SIM Deactivation Vishing
scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate telecommunications commission personnel or mobile network compliance staff, alleging that the subscriber's registered SIM card was flagged for irregular activity and faces immediate deactivation.
scams.legit_en: The National Telecommunications Commission and Philippine mobile carriers never call individual subscribers to demand money, settle regulatory violations over the phone, or request personal banking details to prevent SIM deactivation.
bait_tactics: Oh really, let me think which ID card was used when this SIM was registered, could you repeat the reference details slowly?
Give me a moment please, someone is knocking at the front gate for water delivery, go ahead and explain the notice again.
The signal indoors keeps cutting out every few seconds, could you repeat your office division name one more time?

scams.name: Online Task and Commission Deposit Recruitment Scam
scams.name_en: Part-Time Online Task and Advance Deposit Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers follow up on unsolicited recruitment messages promising easy daily income for completing simple online product-rating or e-commerce tasks.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate Philippine employers and licensed e-commerce platforms never cold-call applicants to offer paid clicking tasks or require workers to deposit personal money into external accounts before releasing earned compensation or commissions.
bait_tactics: Wait, I'm not very familiar with how online merchant tasks work, could you walk me through how the organization is registered first?
Hold on a bit, my phone battery is almost drained and I can't find my charger cable, could you explain the schedule again?
Sorry, the rain on the roof just got really loud here, could you repeat what kind of work contract comes with that?

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.prevalence_note: New Zealand 2025-2026 warnings: bank Fraud and Security Team Impersonation Scam; remote Access IT and Telecommunications Support Scam; government Tax and Official Agency Impersonation Scam; impersonated Family Emergency Money Scam.
NZ.cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from overseas call centres in English.

scams.name: Bank Fraud Team Impersonation Scam
scams.name_en: Bank Fraud and Security Team Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers spoof official bank numbers and claim to be from the bank's fraud or security team investigating an unauthorized overseas payment.
scams.legit_en: Real banks in Australia and New Zealand never ask customers to share passwords, PINs, or one-time verification codes over the phone, and never tell customers to move money into a separate safe account.
bait_tactics: Oh gosh, that sounds worrying—my banking app is spinning on a loading screen right now, could you tell me which account type that payment came from?
Sorry, the mobile reception in the back room here is patchy—could you slowly repeat your reference number while I grab a notepad?
I never read codes out over the phone, so how about you pop a secure message inside my banking app inbox and I'll check it properly?

scams.name: Remote Access Tech and Broadband Scam
scams.name_en: Remote Access IT and Telecommunications Support Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: log into your online banking to check

scams.signals_en: Callers claim to represent a telecommunications provider, internet service team, or computer security department, warning that the recipient's broadband line or computer has been hacked.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate telecommunications carriers and software providers in Australia and New Zealand never make unsolicited phone calls asking users to install remote-access tools, and never ask customers to open online banking during troubleshooting.
bait_tactics: Hang on, my laptop takes ages to boot up after an update—which error message did you say my modem was sending through?
I'm only on a mobile handset right now and don't have a computer in front of me, can you post out a letter explaining the line fault?
The wireless network in this part of the house keeps dropping out, could you walk me through what the issue is without installing anything?

scams.name: Government Tax and Anti-Scam Agency Impersonation
scams.name_en: Government Tax and Official Agency Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers pretend to be tax officers, police, or national anti-scam investigators, claiming an overdue tax debt or alleging the victim's mobile number was linked to overseas fraud.
scams.legit_en: Government revenue offices and anti-scam agencies in Australia and New Zealand never threaten immediate arrest by phone, never ask for portal passwords, and never demand payment via gift cards or cryptocurrency.
bait_tactics: Right, our tax paperwork is filed away in the study—could you give me the correspondence reference so we can check our official online inbox?
That sounds like a mix-up, could you repeat your department name slowly while I jot it down to verify through the main switchboard?
I can't open any links or portals while I'm on a voice call, so is an official notice already on its way in the post?

scams.name: Urgent Family or Friend New-Number Scam
scams.name_en: Impersonated Family Emergency Money Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: transfer money urgently to this account
pay this invoice for me right now

scams.signals_en: Callers pose as a close family member or friend calling from an unfamiliar number, claiming their phone was broken or lost and they are in an urgent bind or accident.
scams.legit_en: Real relatives with a broken phone can still confirm shared family details or wait while you ring their original number or check with another family member on a separate channel.
bait_tactics: Oh goodness, the line sounds really muffled—which cousin is this again, and what happened to your usual number?
I don't have banking set up on this handset, let me quickly ring your old phone or check with the rest of the family first.
Slow down a bit so I can catch what happened—whereabouts are you right now, and why is it a different bank account?

IL.name: Israel
IL.prevalence_note: Israel 2025-2026 warnings: fake Bank or Credit Card Security Department Scam; fake Police and Telecom Remote-Access Vishing Scam; fake Postal and Customs Held Parcel Fee Scam.
IL.cross_border_note: Calls in Hebrew, Russian, Arabic or English; spoofed bank numbers are common.

scams.name: התחזות למחלקת הביטחון של הבנק או חברת האשראי
scams.name_en: Fake Bank or Credit Card Security Department Scam
scams.signals_en: Spoofing an official bank or card-company telephone number, the caller claims to be from the bank security department investigating an unauthorized transaction.
scams.legit_en: The Bank of Israel and Israeli National Cyber Directorate state that genuine banks and card issuers never ask customers to reveal SMS verification codes, account passwords, or transfer savings into external accounts over the phone.
bait_tactics: רגע, הקליטה פה בחדר הפנימי ממש חלשה ולא הגיע שום מסרון, תן לי שנייה לצאת לסלון לבדוק אם יש קליטה.
האפליקציה של הבנק נתקעה לי על מסך הטעינה, מאיזה סניף בדיוק אמרת שאתה מתקשר אליי?
אני לא מוצא את המשקפיים שלי כדי לקרוא מה כתוב על המסך, תוכל לחזור שוב לאט על מספר הפנייה?

scams.name: התחזות למשטרה ולחברת תקשורת להתקנת שליטה מרחוק
scams.name_en: Fake Police and Telecom Remote-Access Vishing Scam
scams.signals_en: Frequently targeting seniors and immigrants, scammers impersonate police officers, telecom technicians, and bank staff in coordinated calls.
scams.legit_en: Israel Police and telecom operators never instruct citizens to install remote-access apps on phones or computers, and police never ask anyone to withdraw cash or transfer funds into so-called protected police accounts.
bait_tactics: הטלפון כותב לי שאין מספיק מקום אחסון להוריד שום דבר עכשיו, תחכה רגע שאני אבדוק מה תופס מקום.
האינטרנט הביתי התנתק לי בדיוק לפני דקה ואני מנסה לחבר אותו מחדש, מאיזו תחנה אמרת שאתה מדבר?
יש לי רעש מהשיפוצים של השכנים ואני בקושי שומע אותך, תוכל לאיית לי שוב את השם והתפקיד שלך?

scams.name: התחזות לדואר ולמכס לשחרור חבילה מעוכבת
scams.name_en: Fake Postal and Customs Held Parcel Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Following up on phishing texts or calling directly as postal or customs staff, the caller claims an international package is detained due to unpaid customs duty or incomplete address data.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate postal and customs notifications in Israel are verified independently using the official tracking number on the official postal portal, and couriers never ask for one-time SMS banking codes by phone.
bait_tactics: אני מחכה לכמה הזמנות שונות ולא יודע על איזו חבילה מדובר, מה מספר המעקב שמופיע אצלך במערכת?
אני בדיוק במעלית והשיחה מתנתקת כל רגע, תמתין שנייה שאני אצא החוצה ואבדוק בהודעות שלי.
הארנק שלי נשאר בתיק בחדר השני, תגיד לי קודם מאיזו מדינה החבילה נשלחה ומתי היא הגיעה?

MN.name: Mongolia
MN.prevalence_note: Mongolia 2025-2026 warnings: verification Code and Phishing Link Account Takeover Scam; online Task and High-Return Commission Scam; bank Account Mule and Fake Bank Security Call Scam; fake Lottery Winner and Telecom Bonus Scam.
MN.cross_border_note: Calls and links come in Mongolian, sometimes from foreign numbers.

scams.name: Баталгаажуулах код болон хуурамч холбоосын залилан
scams.name_en: Verification Code and Phishing Link Account Takeover Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as telecom staff, survey organizers, or acquaintances claiming a six-digit or four-digit verification code was accidentally sent to the victim's phone or needed to confirm an online survey.
scams.legit_en: Mongolian mobile network operators, commercial banks, and government agencies never call citizens to request SMS one-time verification codes or account passwords, and consistently warn users never to share login codes with anyone.
bait_tactics: Өө тийм үү, миний утсанд одоохондоо ямар ч мессэж ирээгүй байна шүү дээ, сүлжээ жаахан муу байгаа юм болов уу?
Би нүдний шилээ өөр өрөөнд орхичихсон болохоор жижиг тоо харагддаггүй ээ, ямар учиртай бүртгэл гэдгийг дахиад тайлбарлаад өгөөч?
Утасны цэнэг дуусах гээд дэлгэц нь бүдгэрчихлээ, албан ёсны салбар дээр нь өөрөө очоод шалгуулж болох уу?

scams.name: Даалгавар биелүүлж мөнгө өсгөх цахим залилан
scams.name_en: Online Task and High-Return Commission Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers call or follow up on messaging apps offering easy part-time income for liking posts or completing online order tasks.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate employers, recruitment agencies, and e-commerce platforms in Mongolia pay salaries under formal contracts and never require workers or customers to deposit personal funds into private bank accounts to unlock commissions.
bait_tactics: Ямар сонин ажил вэ, гэхдээ миний утасны интернэт дата дуусчихсан болохоор одоо юу ч нээж чадахгүй байна аа.
Байгууллагын албан ёсны гэрээ, татвар төлөгчийн бүртгэл нь хаана байдаг юм бол, цаасаар авч үзэж болох уу?
Гэрийнхэн маань хүний данс руу урьдчилж мөнгө хийж болохгүй гэж захисан болохоор би эхлээд сайн лавлаж асууя даа.

scams.name: Данс ашиглуулах болон банкны ажилтан нэр барьсан залилан
scams.name_en: Bank Account Mule and Fake Bank Security Call Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers either impersonate bank security staff claiming suspicious transfers require immediate login verification, or offer quick cash rewards to borrow or rent the recipient's personal bank account and mobile banking access, turning victims into money.
scams.legit_en: The Bank of Mongolia, commercial banks, and police strictly warn never to let others use personal bank accounts and confirm that bank staff never request online banking passwords by phone.
bait_tactics: Аль салбараас ярьж байна гэлээ? Гадаа салхитай байгаад сайн сонсогдсонгүй, та дахиад тодруулаад хэлээд өгөөч?
Би банкны аппликейшнээ гар утсан дээрээ суулгаагүй ээ, маргааш өөрийн биеэр салбар дээр нь очоод шалгуулчихъя.
Манай дансны дэвтэр гэрт цоожтой шүүгээнд байгаа, яг ямар гүйлгээ гарсан гэдгийг цаг минуттай нь хэлж өгөх үү?

scams.name: Сугалааны азтан боллоо гэх урамшууллын залилан
scams.name_en: Fake Lottery Winner and Telecom Bonus Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers announce that the recipient's phone number won a major prize, cash lottery, or telecom promotion.
scams.legit_en: Official Mongolian companies and licensed mobile telecom operators publish verified prize promotions exclusively on official portals and never require lucky-draw winners to wire advance fees to personal accounts or disclose banking PINs.
bait_tactics: Үгүй ээ мөн сонин юм даа, би ерөөсөө сугалаанд бүртгүүлээгүй санагдах юм, хэзээ явагдсан сугалаа билээ?
Шимтгэл шилжүүлэх боломж одоо алга байна аа, шагналыг нь танай төв байран дээр өөрөө очоод харж байж авч болох уу?
Утасны дуу сулхан сонсогдоод байна, ямар байгууллагын урамшуулал гэдгийг удаан тод хэлээд өгөөч?

MM.name: Myanmar
MM.prevalence_note: Myanmar 2025-2026 warnings: mobile Wallet OTP and Device-Change Takeover Scam; fake Telecom Operator Promotion and Prize Scam; fake Proxy VPN and Malicious APK Remote Control Scam; fake High-Yield Forex and Gold Investment Scam.
MM.cross_border_note: Calls and app links in Burmese, often from Thai or foreign numbers.

scams.name: မိုဘိုင်းပိုက်ဆံအိတ် OTP နှင့် PIN လိမ်လည်မှု
scams.name_en: Mobile Wallet OTP and Device-Change Takeover Scam
context_keywords: အကောင့်အဆင့်မြှင့်
စက်ပြောင်း

red_flag_keywords.text: အကောင့်ပိတ်သိမ်းမည်

scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate mobile wallet or bank customer support staff, claiming your digital wallet requires urgent level-two identity verification, system maintenance, or reversal of a mistaken transfer.
scams.legit_en: The Central Bank of Myanmar and licensed mobile wallet providers state that official staff never call customers to ask for OTPs, passwords, or PINs, and advise users to contact official customer service channels directly if suspicious activity occurs.
bait_tactics: ခဏလေးနော်၊ ဒီဘက်မှာ မီးပျက်သွားလို့ အင်တာနက်လိုင်းပါ ကျနေပြီး ဖုန်းအက်ပ်က လုံးဝဖွင့်မရသေးဘူး။
စာတိုက ဒီဖုန်းထဲ ဝင်မလာသေးဘူး၊ ဖုန်းလိုင်းက တစ်တုံးပဲမိနေလို့ ခဏစောင့်ပေးပါဦးနော်။
အကောင့်ဖွင့်ထားတဲ့ ဆင်းမ်ကဒ်က အိမ်ကနောက်ဖုန်းတစ်လုံးထဲမှာ ထည့်ထားတာမို့လို့ အခုလက်ထဲမရှိသေးဘူးနော်။

scams.name: ဖုန်းအော်ပရေတာအမည်ခံ ကံစမ်းမဲလိမ်လည်မှု
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Operator Promotion and Prize Scam
context_keywords: ကံစမ်းမဲပေါက်
အခွန်ဆောင်

red_flag_keywords.text: ဘဏ်အကောင့်စကားဝှက်
ဆုထုတ်ယူခပေးချေပါ

scams.signals_en: Scammers call or message pretending to represent major mobile telecom operators, congratulating you on winning a large cash or gold promotion prize.
scams.legit_en: Major telecom operators in Myanmar confirm they never request money transfers, account passwords, or mobile wallet details to claim prizes, and contact genuine promotion winners exclusively through verified official shortcodes.
bait_tactics: ဟုတ်လား၊ ဘယ်တုန်းက ကံစမ်းမဲလဲမသိဘူး၊ အပြင်မှာ မိုးသံတွေဆူနေလို့ ပြန်ပြောပေးပါဦးနော်။
မှတ်ပုံတင်က အိမ်ကဗီရိုထဲမှာ သော့ခတ်ထားလို့ အခုချက်ချင်း ကြည့်ပြောလို့ မရသေးဘူးဖြစ်နေတယ်။
ဖုန်းအားက နှစ်ရာခိုင်နှုန်းပဲ ကျန်တော့လို့ စက်ပိတ်တော့မယ်၊ အားသွင်းကြိုး အရင်ရှာလိုက်ဦးမယ်နော်။

scams.name: အတုအယောင် VPN နှင့် ပြင်ပ APK လင့်ခ်လိမ်လည်မှု
scams.name_en: Fake Proxy VPN and Malicious APK Remote Control Scam
context_keywords: ဖုန်းထိန်းချုပ်
ပြင်ပလင့်ခ်

red_flag_keywords.text: ဒီလင့်ခ်ကနေ ဒေါင်းလုတ်ဆွဲပါ

scams.signals_en: Exploiting everyday network proxy needs or posing as technical and customer support staff, callers urge you to tap an unfamiliar link to install a proxy tool, media app, or wallet update.
scams.legit_en: Financial institutions and mobile wallet providers in Myanmar never send third-party APK files or proxy download links over phone calls or messages, and advise customers to update banking applications exclusively through official app stores.
bait_tactics: ဖုန်းထဲမှာ မမ်မိုရီပြည့်နေလို့ ဘာဖိုင်မှ ထပ်ဒေါင်းလို့ မရတော့ဘူးဖြစ်နေတယ်နော်။
ဖုန်းက အဟောင်းလေးမို့လို့ မျက်နှာပြင်က ဟန်းနေပြီး ဘာမှနှိပ်မရသေးဘူး ခဏစောင့်ပါနော်။

scams.name: အတိုးနှုန်းမြင့် အွန်လိုင်းရင်းနှီးမြှုပ်နှံမှု လိမ်လည်မှု
scams.name_en: Fake High-Yield Forex and Gold Investment Scam
context_keywords: နေ့စဉ်အမြတ်

red_flag_keywords.text: နေ့စဉ်အတိုးအမြတ်ရမည်
ငွေထုတ်ရန်အခွန်အရင်သွင်းပါ

scams.signals_en: Callers promote online gold, real estate, or foreign currency trading groups falsely claiming cooperation or licensing from the Central Bank of Myanmar.
scams.legit_en: The Central Bank of Myanmar warns the public that authorized banks offer regulated annual interest rates rather than guaranteed daily payouts, and never partner with unlicensed online forex or gold investment promoters soliciting direct transfers.
bait_tactics: စိတ်ဝင်စားဖို့တော့ ကောင်းသားပဲ၊ ဒါပေမဲ့ အိမ်ကမိသားစုနဲ့ အရင်တိုင်ပင်ကြည့်ရဦးမှာမို့လို့ အချက်အလက်လေး ပြန်ပြောပေးပါဦး။
လောလောဆယ် လက်ထဲမှာ ငွေသားပဲရှိပြီး အကောင့်ထဲ ငွေမထည့်ရသေးလို့ အပြင်ထွက်မှပဲ ကြည့်ရမယ်နော်။

LA.name: Laos
LA.prevalence_note: Laos 2025-2026 warnings: mobile Banking App OTP Account Takeover; forged Official Notice and SIM Registration Vishing Scam; fake Family Accident or Arrest Urgent Money Scam; fake Lucky Draw Prize Handling-Fee Scam.
LA.cross_border_note: Calls in Lao or Thai, often from Thai numbers.

scams.name: ການຫຼອກຂໍລະຫັດ OTP ແອັບທະນາຄານ
scams.name_en: Mobile Banking App OTP Account Takeover
context_keywords: ບັນຊີຖືກລະງັບ

red_flag_keywords.text: ກົດລິ້ງເພື່ອຢືນຢັນ
ບັນຊີຈະຖືກອາຍັດ

scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate commercial bank officers, claiming your mobile banking account faces imminent suspension within twenty-four hours or requires urgent security verification.
scams.legit_en: Commercial banks and Lao cybersecurity authorities emphasize that banks never ask customers for OTPs, PINs, or passwords verbally or via SMS links.
bait_tactics: ຖ້າບຶດໜຶ່ງເດີ້, ຕອນນີ້ສັນຍານອິນເຕີເນັດຢູ່ເຮືອນຂ້ອຍຊ້າຫຼາຍ ເປີດແອັບທະນາຄານບໍ່ທັນຂຶ້ນເທື່ອ.
ຍັງບໍ່ເຫັນມີຂໍ້ຄວາມຫຍັງສົ່ງເຂົ້າມາເລີຍ, ຊິມທີ່ຜູກບັນຊີໄວ້ຢູ່ໃນໂທລະສັບອີກໜ່ວຍໜຶ່ງທີ່ແບັດໝົດ.
ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ໄດ້ໃສ່ແວ່ນຕາ ອ່ານໂຕເລກນ້ອຍໆໃນໜ້າຈໍບໍ່ເຫັນເລີຍ, ຂໍຍ່າງໄປຊອກແວ່ນຕາໃນຫ້ອງກ່ອນເດີ້.

scams.name: ການແອບອ້າງເຈົ້າໜ້າທີ່ລັດ ແລະ ລົງທະບຽນຊິມກາດ
scams.name_en: Forged Official Notice and SIM Registration Vishing Scam
context_keywords: ຄ່າໂທຄ້າງຊຳລະ
ເອກະສານທາງການ

red_flag_keywords.text: ສົ່ງຮູບບັດປະຈຳຕົວ
ໂອນເງິນເພື່ອກວດສອບ
ຈະຖືກຕັດເບີທັນທີ

scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate telecommunications ministry officials, public security officers, or mobile carrier staff, citing overdue communication fees or forged government SIM registration notices.
scams.legit_en: Lao ministries and telecom operators never demand banking passwords, OTPs, or money transfers over phone calls. Citizens should hang up immediately and verify SIM registration status directly at official telecom service centers.
bait_tactics: ສຽງລົດຢູ່ແຄມທາງດັງແຮງຫຼາຍ ຟັງບໍ່ຄ່ອຍແຈ້ງເລີຍ, ເຈົ້າເວົ້າຊື່ໜ່ວຍງານຄືນອີກເທື່ອໜຶ່ງໄດ້ບໍ່?
ບັດປະຈຳຕົວຂ້ອຍເກັບໄວ້ໃນຕູ້ຢູ່ເຮືອນພຸ້ນ, ຕອນນີ້ຂ້ອຍອອກມາຊື້ເຄື່ອງຢູ່ຕະຫຼາດ ບໍ່ໄດ້ຖືມານຳເດີ້.
ຊິມເບີນີ້ລູກຫຼານເປັນຄົນຊື້ມາໃສ່ເຄື່ອງໃຫ້, ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ຈື່ຂໍ້ມູນຕອນລົງທະບຽນເລີຍ ຖ້າຖາມລາວກ່ອນເດີ້.

scams.name: ການແອບອ້າງເປັນພີ່ນ້ອງເກີດອຸບັດຕິເຫດຂໍໂອນເງິນດ່ວນ
scams.name_en: Fake Family Accident or Arrest Urgent Money Scam
context_keywords: ໂອນເງິນດ່ວນ
ຢ່າຟ້າວບອກໃຜ

red_flag_keywords.text: ໂອນເງິນມາດ່ວນດຽວນີ້
ໂອນເຂົ້າບັນຊີຄົນອື່ນກ່ອນ

scams.signals_en: Callers pretend to be a family member, hospital staff, or traffic officer, claiming a relative has just suffered a road accident or been detained and urgently needs medical or bail money.
scams.legit_en: Hospitals and public security offices in Laos never demand instant transfers to personal accounts over an unverified phone call. Authorities advise hanging up immediately and calling the family member's original number directly to verify.
bait_tactics: ແມ່ນໃຜເກີດເຫດເກາະ? ສຽງໂທລະສັບມັນຂາດໆຫາຍໆ ຟັງຊື່ບໍ່ອອກເລີຍ ເວົ້າຊ້າໆແດ່ເດີ້.
ໃນບັນຊີໂທລະສັບຂ້ອຍຕອນນີ້ບໍ່ມີເງິນພໍເລີຍ, ຕ້ອງໄດ້ລໍຖ້າໃຫ້ຄົນຢູ່ເຮືອນກັບມາເບິ່ງຊ່ວຍກ່ອນ.
ເຈົ້າຢູ່ຄຸ້ມໃດແທ້ລະ? ຂ້ອຍກຳລັງຊອກເຈ້ຍກັບບິກມາຈົດໄວ້ ແຕ່ຍັງຊອກບິກບໍ່ເຫັນເທື່ອ.

scams.name: ການຫຼອກລວງວ່າຖືກລາງວັນພິເສດໃຫ້ໂອນຄ່າທຳນຽມ
scams.name_en: Fake Lucky Draw Prize Handling-Fee Scam
context_keywords: ລົງທະບຽນຮັບສິດ

red_flag_keywords.text: ຄ່າທຳນຽມກ່ອນ
ປ້ອນຂໍ້ມູນບັນຊີທະນາຄານ

scams.signals_en: Callers or messages congratulate you on winning a lucky draw cash prize, smartphone, or vehicle promotion you never entered.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate companies and telecom operators in Laos never require promotion winners to pay advance handling fees to personal accounts or disclose mobile banking passwords, and authorities urge reporting suspicious prize calls to official cybercrime hotlines.
bait_tactics: ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ເຄີຍສົ່ງຊື່ຊິງໂຊກຢູ່ໃສເລີຍໃດ໋, ແມ່ນລາຍການຫຍັງເກາະ ລອງເລົ່າໃໝ່ຊ້າໆເບິ່ງດູ.
ຕອນນີ້ຝົນຕົກແຮງ ສັນຍານໂທລະສັບຢູ່ບ້ານຂ້ອຍມັນຂາດໆ, ເປີດເບິ່ງຫຍັງໃນມືຖືບໍ່ໄດ້ເລີຍເດີ້.
ຂ້ອຍໂອນເງິນຜ່ານມືຖືບໍ່ເປັນເລີຍ, ຕ້ອງຖ້າໃຫ້ຄົນໃນຄອບຄົວເລີກວຽກກັບມາເຮືອນຕອນແລງພຸ້ນເດີ້.

BD.name: Bangladesh
BD.prevalence_note: Bangladesh 2025-2026 warnings: mobile Financial Service PIN and OTP Takeover Scam; spoofed Emergency Helpline and Police Case Extortion; fake Low-Interest Loan Advance Fee Scam; fake Mobile Lottery and Prize Clearance Scam.
BD.cross_border_note: Calls in Bengali, often from local mobile numbers.

scams.name: মোবাইল ব্যাংকিং পিন ও ওটিপি প্রতারণা
scams.name_en: Mobile Financial Service PIN and OTP Takeover Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as mobile financial service customer care agents—or claim cash was mistakenly sent to your mobile wallet—warning that your account will be blocked within minutes unless updated.
scams.legit_en: Mobile financial service providers and Bangladesh Bank emphasize that official staff and agents never ask for a user's PIN or SMS OTP over the phone. Customers should verify account issues exclusively through verified official customer helplines.
bait_tactics: ভাই, একটু ধরুন, এলাকায় কারেন্ট চলে গেছে আর রাউটার বন্ধ হয়ে যাওয়ায় মোবাইলের অ্যাপটা একদম খুলছে না।
আমার এই ফোনে তো কোনো মেসেজ আসেনি, যে সিমে অ্যাকাউন্ট খোলা সেটা অন্য ঘরে চার্জে দেওয়া আছে।
চশমাটা হাতের কাছে নেই তো, ফোনের ছোট লেখাগুলো একদম ঝাপসা দেখছি, একটু সময় দিন।

scams.name: জরুরি সেবা ও পুলিশ পরিচয়ে মামলা নিষ্পত্তি প্রতারণা
scams.name_en: Spoofed Emergency Helpline and Police Case Extortion
scams.signals_en: Fraudsters spoof the national emergency service number or impersonate police station officers, claiming a criminal case or formal complaint has been filed against you.
scams.legit_en: Bangladesh Police confirm that the national emergency helpline handles only police, fire, and ambulance dispatches. Law enforcement officers never call citizens to demand money, settle cases over the phone, or ask for mobile banking PINs.
bait_tactics: স্যার, রাস্তায় রিকশা আর গাড়ির প্রচণ্ড হর্নের শব্দে আপনার কথা কেটে কেটে যাচ্ছে, কোন জায়গার কথা বললেন?
আমি তো একটু বাইরে বাজারে এসেছি, কাগজপত্র সব বাসার আলমারিতে তালা দেওয়া আছে।
নেটওয়ার্ক বারবার ছেড়ে দিচ্ছে স্যার, কথা পরিষ্কার শোনা যাচ্ছে না, একটু দাঁড়ান আমি জানালার পাশে যাচ্ছি।

scams.name: অনলাইন ঋণ ও অগ্রিম জামানত প্রতারণা
scams.name_en: Fake Low-Interest Loan Advance Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as loan officers from international development agencies, microfinance bodies, or digital lending platforms, offering instant low-interest loans without collateral.
scams.legit_en: Bangladesh Police Cyber Police Center warns that genuine banks and international organizations never issue personal loans via unknown numbers or social media links, and never demand advance security deposits or tax transfers to personal mobile wallets.
bait_tactics: আমি তো এখন অফিসে কাজের ভেতর আছি, মোবাইল ওয়ালেটে এখন কোনো ব্যালেন্সই নেই যে পাঠাব।
আপনাদের অফিসের নিয়মটা একটু ধীরে বলুন তো, আমি খাতা আর কলমটা খুঁজে লিখে নিচ্ছি।
ফোনে কথা বলার সময় আমার সিমে ইন্টারনেট ডেটা কাজ করে না, তাই কোনো ফর্ম এখন খোলা যাচ্ছে না।

scams.name: লটারি ও উপহার জেতার ফি প্রতারণা
scams.name_en: Fake Mobile Lottery and Prize Clearance Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers congratulate you on winning a telecom SIM lucky draw, television prize, or overseas gift parcel, then insist that government tax, customs duty, or registration charges must be transferred immediately through a mobile wallet account before the.
scams.legit_en: Telecom operators and licensed institutions in Bangladesh never ask promotion winners to send advance tax or clearance fees to personal mobile wallet numbers, and never request account PINs or OTPs to disburse prizes.
bait_tactics: আমি তো কোনো লটারির টিকিটই কিনিনি ভাই, আপনি কি ভুল নম্বরে কল করলেন নাকি একটু দেখুন তো।
পাশের বাড়িতে ছাদে কাজ চলছে তো, হাতুড়ির শব্দে আপনার কথা কিছুই বোঝা যাচ্ছে না।
পুরস্কারের টাকা থেকে ফি কেটে রেখে বাকিটা পাঠানোর নিয়ম আছে কি না আমাকে একটু পরে জানান, আমার ফোনের চার্জ শেষ।

PK.name: Pakistan
PK.prevalence_note: Pakistan 2025-2026 warnings: fake Welfare Subsidy Verification Call; fake Telecom Regulator SIM and Mobile Wallet OTP Scam; spoofed Bank Helpline Card Block and Mistaken Transfer Scam; fake Courier or Network USSD Call Forwarding Hijack.
PK.cross_border_note: Calls in Urdu or English, often from spoofed bank or government numbers.

scams.name: سرکاری امدادی پروگرام کی جعلی کال
scams.name_en: Fake Welfare Subsidy Verification Call
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to speak from a national welfare support office using an ordinary ten-digit mobile number rather than an official government shortcode.
scams.legit_en: Pakistan's welfare support agency sends official eligibility notifications exclusively from its verified government shortcode and operates an official toll-free helpline.
bait_tactics: اچھا جی، ذرا رکیے، گھر میں سگنل بہت کم آ رہے ہیں، آپ کی آواز کٹ رہی ہے۔
میری عینک دوسرے کمرے میں رکھی ہے، کارڈ کے ہندسے ابھی صاف نظر نہیں آ رہے۔
فون پر ابھی تک کوئی پیغام نہیں آیا، شاید نیٹ ورک سست چل رہا ہے، ایک منٹ ٹھہریں۔

scams.name: سم کارڈ اور موبائل والٹ بندش کا جعلی او ٹی پی فراڈ
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Regulator SIM and Mobile Wallet OTP Scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonating telecom regulator staff or mobile wallet support, the caller warns that the user's SIM card, device registration, or digital wallet will be blocked within five minutes due to incomplete verification.
scams.legit_en: Neither the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority nor licensed mobile wallet providers ever phone users to request OTPs, five-digit PINs, or passwords.
bait_tactics: جی میں سن رہا ہوں لیکن دوسرے فون پر میسج آتا ہے اور اس کی بیٹری بالکل ختم ہو گئی ہے۔
چارجر ڈھونڈ رہا ہوں، بجلی ابھی گئی ہوئی ہے تو تھوڑا وقت لگ رہا ہے۔
ایک سیکنڈ رکیے، سکرین لاک کھل نہیں رہا، میں دوبارہ چیک کر کے دیکھتا ہوں۔

scams.name: جعلی بینک ہیلپ لائن اور کارڈ بلاک فراڈ کال
scams.name_en: Spoofed Bank Helpline Card Block and Mistaken Transfer Scam
scams.signals_en: Using a spoofed bank helpline number on caller ID, the fraudster claims a debit card has been frozen after a suspicious debit or alleges money was sent to the victim's account by mistake.
scams.legit_en: Under State Bank of Pakistan consumer protection guidance, bank helplines primarily receive inbound customer calls and never make unsolicited calls asking for PINs, CVVs, passwords, or OTPs.
bait_tactics: ہولڈ کیجیے گا، میں ذرا بٹوے میں دیکھوں کہ کارڈ کس جیب میں رکھا ہوا ہے۔
بینک کی ایپ کھولنے کی کوشش کر رہا ہوں مگر انٹرنیٹ بالکل نہیں چل رہا۔
ذرا آہستہ بولیے، باہر گلی میں شور بہت زیادہ ہے، مجھے آپ کی بات سمجھ نہیں آئی۔

scams.name: کوریئر یا نیٹ ورک کے بہانے کال فارورڈنگ کوڈ فراڈ
scams.name_en: Fake Courier or Network USSD Call Forwarding Hijack

red_flag_keywords.text: یہ کوڈ ملا کر کال کریں

scams.signals_en: Posing as a parcel delivery rider unable to locate an address or a mobile network technician fixing signal issues, the caller instructs the victim to open their phone dialer and dial a star-hash USSD string starting with *21* or *62* followed by an.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate couriers and telecom operators never ask customers to dial USSD call-diversion codes prefixed with *21* or *62* plus a stranger's mobile number.
bait_tactics: میری کال چل رہی ہے تو ڈائل پیڈ میرے فون پر کھل ہی نہیں رہا، کیسے دباؤں؟
ایک منٹ، میں کاغذ قلم ڈھونڈ لوں تاکہ بعد میں تسلی سے دیکھ سکوں۔
قلم کی سیاہی ختم ہو گئی ہے، ذرا ٹھہریے میں پنسل لے کر آتا ہوں۔

NP.name: Nepal
NP.prevalence_note: Nepal 2025-2026 warnings: digital Wallet and Mobile Banking KYC OTP Scam; overseas Gift Parcel and Customs Fee Scam; fake Lucky Draw and Cash Prize Advance-Fee Scam; fake Online Job Fee and Money-Mule Account Scam.
NP.cross_border_note: Calls in Nepali or Hindi, sometimes from Indian or foreign numbers.

scams.name: मोबाइल बैंकिङ र डिजिटल वालेट केवाईसी ओटीपी ठगी
scams.name_en: Digital Wallet and Mobile Banking KYC OTP Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as a digital wallet service center or commercial bank officer, the caller warns that the user's account will be blocked within hours due to an expired KYC profile or suspicious login.
scams.legit_en: Nepal Rastra Bank and the Nepal Police Cyber Bureau emphasize that licensed banks and digital wallet providers never call customers to ask for OTPs, PINs, or account recovery codes.
bait_tactics: हजुर एकछिन है, मेरो अर्को फोनमा म्यासेज आउँछ तर त्यो फोन अर्कै कोठामा चार्जमा छ।
यहाँ नेटवर्क एकदमै कमजोर छ हजुर, म्यासेज आउनै ढिला भइरहेको छ।
पख्नुस् न, मैले चस्मा नलगाई मोबाइलको अक्षर नै राम्ररी देखिनँ, चस्मा खोज्दैछु।

scams.name: विदेशबाट आएको उपहार र भन्सार पार्सल ठगी
scams.name_en: Overseas Gift Parcel and Customs Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be a customs clearing agent or courier officer holding a valuable parcel containing electronics, jewelry, or foreign currency sent from abroad.
scams.legit_en: Nepal Customs offices and licensed courier operators issue official tracked notices and collect statutory duties exclusively through government revenue counters or authorized banking channels, never demanding urgent transfers into personal mobile wallets.
bait_tactics: ए हो र हजुर? विदेशमा त मेरो आफन्त कोही हुनुहुन्न जस्तो लाग्छ, कुन देशबाट आएको भन्नुभयो?
मेरो मोबाइल बैंकिङ एप हिजोदेखि लगइन नै भइरहेको छैन, म भरै घरको मान्छे आएपछि हेर्न लगाउँछु।
एकैछिन रोक्नुस् है, ढोकामा कोही बोलाइरहेको जस्तो छ, आवाज राम्ररी बुझिएन।

scams.name: चिट्ठा र नगद पुरस्कार परेको प्रलोभन ठगी
scams.name_en: Fake Lucky Draw and Cash Prize Advance-Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Calling from an international or unknown number on cellular lines or chat apps, the scammer congratulates the user on winning millions of rupees in a telecom promotion or television quiz draw they never entered.
scams.legit_en: Nepali telecom operators and Nepal Police advise that genuine promotional draws never contact winners via foreign numbers or require upfront tax or processing fee transfers to claim prizes, and never request secret PINs or OTP codes.
bait_tactics: साँच्चै हो र हजुर? मैले त कुनै चिट्ठामा भाग लिएको यादै छैन, म कापी कलम खोजेर टिप्छु है।
कलम नै भेटिएन हजुर, एकछिन पख्नुस् म दराजमा हेर्दैछु।
तपाईंको आवाज अलि काटिएर आयो, बिस्तारै फेरि सुरुदेखि भनिदिनुस् न।

scams.name: अनलाइन रोजगारी दर्ता शुल्क र खाता भाडा ठगी
scams.name_en: Fake Online Job Fee and Money-Mule Account Scam
scams.signals_en: Targeting young adults and job seekers, the caller promises high-paying remote tasks, overseas employment placement, or easy commissions for receiving and forwarding funds through the user's bank or wallet account.
scams.legit_en: Nepal Rastra Bank's Financial Information Unit and Nepal Police warn that legitimate employers do not charge upfront registration fees over phone calls, and lending personal bank or wallet accounts for third-party commissions exposes account holders to.
bait_tactics: हजुर म अहिले बाहिर हिँडिरहेको छु, घर पुगेर परिवारसँग सल्लाह नगरी केही बुझिँदैन।
मोबाइलमा ब्याट्री दुई प्रतिशत मात्र बाँकी छ, जतिबेला पनि निभ्न सक्छ है।
यहाँ गाडीको हर्नले केही सुनिएन हजुर, एकछिन पख्नुस् म शान्त ठाउँतिर सर्छु।

LK.name: Sri Lanka
LK.prevalence_note: Sri Lanka 2025-2026 warnings: fake Police Traffic Fine and Government Payment Portal Scam; bank and Telecom Impersonation OTP Theft Scam; fake Telecom Lucky Draw Cash Prize Scam; fake Held Postal Parcel and Customs Clearance Scam.
LK.cross_border_note: Calls in Sinhala, Tamil or English.

scams.name: ව්‍යාජ පොලිස් රථවාහන දඩ සහ රාජ්‍ය ගෙවීම් ඇමතුම් වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Police Traffic Fine and Government Payment Portal Scam
scams.signals_en: Following up on fraudulent SMS alerts or calling directly from unknown numbers, scammers impersonate police or official government payment platform staff regarding an unpaid traffic offence.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka CERT and Sri Lanka Police confirm that traffic fine notices are never enforced via unsolicited phone calls demanding card numbers or OTP codes, and citizens should verify digital government payments strictly on official verified portals.
bait_tactics: පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න, මට වාහනයක් එළවන්නේවත් නැති නිසා මම ගෙදර අයගෙන් අහලා බලන්නම්.
මගේ දුරකථනයට තාම කිසිම කෙටි පණිවිඩයක් ආවේ නැහැ, සිග්නල් හරිම අඩුයි.
විනාඩියක් දෙන්න, මම කණ්ණාඩි දෙක හොයාගන්නකම් අකුරු කියවගන්න අමාරුයි.

scams.name: බැංකු ගිණුම් හෝ දුරකථන සේවා OTP සොරකම් කිරීමේ වංචාව
scams.name_en: Bank and Telecom Impersonation OTP Theft Scam
scams.signals_en: Using spoofed local numbers, the caller poses as a commercial bank officer, Central Bank official, or telecom regulator warning of an unusual account transaction or imminent SIM disconnection.
scams.legit_en: Both the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka warn the public that genuine banks and regulators never request passwords, PINs, OTPs, or personal verification data via phone calls or SMS.
bait_tactics: සමාවෙන්න, එළියේ ලොකු සද්දයක් ඇහෙන නිසා ඔයා කියන දේ පැහැදිලිව ඇහෙන්නේ නැහැ.
මගේ බැංකු පණිවිඩ එන්නේ වෙන දුරකථනයකට, ඒක දැන් ඕෆ් වෙලා තියෙන්නේ.
චාජරය හොයාගෙන ඒක ඔන් කරන්න ටිකක් වෙලා යයි, පොඩ්ඩක් රැඳී ඉන්න.

scams.name: ව්‍යාජ දිනුම් ඇදීම් සහ මුදල් ත්‍යාග ඇමතුම් වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom Lucky Draw Cash Prize Scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonating mobile call center agents, scammers enthusiastically inform the recipient that their mobile number won one or two million rupees in a promotional lucky draw.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka CERT and major Sri Lankan mobile operators repeatedly caution subscribers that legitimate promotional draws never demand OTPs, online banking credentials, or advance fee deposits over the phone to release prize money.
bait_tactics: ඇත්තටමද? මම කිසිම තරඟයකට අයදුම් කළේ නැහැනේ, පෑනක් හොයාගන්නකම් පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න.
මේ පෑනේ තීන්ත ඉවර වෙලා, මම වෙන කොළයකුයි පැන්සලකුයි අරන් එන්නම්.
ඔයා කියන අංක පැටලෙනවා, කරුණාකරලා ආයෙත් හෙමින් මුල ඉඳන් කියන්න පුළුවන්ද?

scams.name: රඳවාගත් තැපැල් පාර්සල් සහ රේගු ගාස්තු වංචාව
scams.name_en: Fake Held Postal Parcel and Customs Clearance Scam
scams.signals_en: Claiming to represent the postal service or customs clearance desk, the caller states an international parcel cannot be delivered due to an incomplete address or unpaid duty.
scams.legit_en: Sri Lanka Post and Sri Lanka CERT warn that postal and customs authorities issue official physical or verified notifications for dutiable items and never send external short links or ask for card CVVs and OTPs by phone.
bait_tactics: මම මෑතකදී පිටරටින් කිසිම පාර්සලයක් ඕඩර් කළේ නැහැ, කවුද එවලා තියෙන්නේ කියලා බලන්න පුළුවන්ද?
මගේ දුරකථනයේ ඉන්ටර්නෙට් ඩේටා ඉවර වෙලා නිසා කිසිම වෙබ් පිටුවක් දැන් ඕපන් වෙන්නේ නැහැ.
පොඩ්ඩක් ඉන්න, ගෙදර තව කෙනෙක් මොනවා හරි ඕඩර් කළාද කියලා මම අහලා එන්නම්.

AF.name: Afghanistan
AF.prevalence_note: Afghanistan 2025-2026 warnings: telecom Prize Lottery and Mobile Credit Card Fraud; fake Humanitarian Cash Aid and Resettlement Registration Scam; fake Overseas Visa Lottery and Work Permit Fee Scam; mobile Wallet and National ID OTP Account Takeover Scam.
AF.cross_border_note: Calls in Pashto or Dari, often from abroad.

scams.name: د ټیلیفوني پچې او جایزې په نوم د کریدت کارت درغلي
scams.name_en: Telecom Prize Lottery and Mobile Credit Card Fraud
scams.signals_en: Calling from ordinary domestic mobile SIM numbers, fraudsters announce that the recipient has won a brand-new car, gold, or household appliances in a telecom draw.
scams.legit_en: According to Afghanistan Telecom Regulatory Authority investigations, legitimate telecom operators announce official promotions only through verified corporate shortcodes and media channels, and never call subscribers from personal mobile numbers.
bait_tactics: اوس خو زما په ټیلیفون کې بیخي کریدت نشته او دوکانونه هم له کوره ډېر لرې دي۔
یوه شېبه صبر وکړئ، دلته انټن ډېر کمزوری دی، ستاسو غږ سم نه راځي۔
زه قلم او کاغذ راواخلم چې ستاسو خبره ولیکم، خو عینکې مې نه پیدا کېږي۔

scams.name: د بشري مرستو او بیا مېشتېدنې د نوملیکنې جعلي اړیکه
scams.name_en: Fake Humanitarian Cash Aid and Resettlement Registration Scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonating international humanitarian agency staff via phone calls and messaging apps, scammers promise priority registration for emergency cash assistance packages or overseas family resettlement.
scams.legit_en: Humanitarian agencies operating in Afghanistan explicitly state that all humanitarian assistance, registration, and resettlement services are completely free of charge, and official aid staff never ask beneficiaries for money, commissions, or transfers.
bait_tactics: وبخښئ، زه د کور له مشرانو سره له مشورې پرته هیڅ اسناد یا شمېره نشم درکولی۔
دا مهال برق تللی او زما د موبایل چارج په ختمېدو دی، خبره مو پرې کېږي۔
مهرباني وکړئ لږ ورو وغږېږئ، بهر شور دی او زه ستاسو خبره سمه نه اورم۔

scams.name: د بهرنۍ ویزې او کاري جواز د پچې جعلي ټیلیفوني درغلي
scams.name_en: Fake Overseas Visa Lottery and Work Permit Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as a foreign consular officer or overseas recruiter, the caller claims the recipient won a diversity visa lottery or foreign work permit.
scams.legit_en: Official diplomatic advisories for Afghanistan emphasize that consular officers never cold-call citizens to announce visa lottery wins or work permits and never request fee transfers to personal or third-country accounts.
bait_tactics: ما خو هیڅ ځای کې د ویزې فورمه نه ده ډکه کړې، تاسو د کوم دفتر نه غږېږئ؟
زما پاسپورټ او کاغذونه دلته نشته، په بل کور کې پاتې دي۔
یوه شېبه، کرښه ډېره خرابه ده او غږ مو غوڅېږي، زه اوس هیڅ نشم لیکلی۔

scams.name: د تذکرې او موبایل حساب د تایید کوډ غلا
scams.name_en: Mobile Wallet and National ID OTP Account Takeover Scam
scams.signals_en: Claiming to call from a commercial bank, mobile money operator, or SIM registration desk, the scammer warns that the user's SIM or mobile wallet will be deactivated unless they confirm their national ID number and read out a newly sent SMS verification.
scams.legit_en: Under Da Afghanistan Bank financial consumer protection rules and telecom SIM registration procedures, identity verification requires in-person biometric registration at authorized branches, and legitimate institutions never ask for OTPs or PINs by phone.
bait_tactics: زما په موبایل کې تر اوسه هیڅ پیغام نه دی راغلی، شبکه ډېره ضعیفه ده۔
تذکره مې په المارۍ کې قلف ده او کیلي اوس زما سره نشته۔
یوه دقیقه صبر وکړئ، بل موبایل مې ګورم خو سکرین یې کار نه کوي۔

IE.name: Ireland
IE.prevalence_note: Ireland 2025-2026 warnings: bank Fraud Team and Safe Account Vishing Scam; tax and Social Protection Authority Impersonation Scam; telecom Regulator and Broadband Disconnection Scam; unsolicited High-Return Investment and Crypto Cold Call.
IE.cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from abroad in English with spoofed local numbers.

scams.name: Bank Fraud Team & Safe Account APP Scam
scams.name_en: Bank Fraud Team and Safe Account Vishing Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: courier to collect your bank card
corrupt staff at your local branch

scams.signals_en: Caller impersonates a bank fraud prevention department in the United Kingdom or Ireland, warning of suspicious card transactions, compromised sort codes, or dishonest branch staff.
scams.legit_en: Real UK and Irish banks never instruct customers to move funds to a safe account, never ask for full PINs or one-time passcodes over the phone, and always encourage hanging up to dial 159 or the card's printed number.
bait_tactics: Hang on a tick, my little card reader is tucked away in the kitchen drawer and the battery was flashing low last week.
Bear with me, the banking app is just spinning because our broadband doesn't quite reach the back room.
Sorry, no text code has come through yet—mobile signal in this stone terrace is dreadful when it's raining.

scams.name: HMRC, Revenue & Social Protection Warrant Scam
scams.name_en: Tax and Social Protection Authority Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: Prerecorded message or aggressive caller claims to represent the tax authority or social protection department, alleging unpaid tax arrears, national insurance or personal public service number fraud, or impending court warrants.
scams.legit_en: Official UK tax authorities and Irish revenue or social protection departments communicate formal liabilities by post or verified government portals, never threaten immediate arrest on unsolicited phone calls, and never request payment via gift vouchers.
bait_tactics: Oh dear, wait a moment while I fetch my reading glasses from the sitting room so I can jot down that reference.
Hang on, the doorbell just went for the postie—could you repeat which tax year you said that balance was for?
I keep all my letters in a ring binder upstairs, give me a minute to check what came in the post.

scams.name: Broadband Disconnection & Telecom Regulator Scam
scams.name_en: Telecom Regulator and Broadband Disconnection Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: broadband will be cut off today
confirm bank details to keep your line

scams.signals_en: Caller claims to be from the telecommunications regulator or a broadband network engineer, stating that the household internet connection will be disconnected today due to malicious traffic, router faults, or an unpaid bill.
scams.legit_en: Telecommunications regulators in the United Kingdom and Ireland never make unsolicited consumer calls about individual broadband lines or bills, and genuine internet providers give advance written notice before any service restriction without requesting.
bait_tactics: Hold on, the router box is tucked behind the telly cabinet and I can't see which little lights are flashing from here.
Wait a minute, my old laptop takes ages to wake up from sleep mode—it's still installing system updates.
Sorry, the kettle just boiled right beside me and I missed what programme name you wanted me to look at.

scams.name: High-Return Share & Crypto Cold-Call Scam
scams.name_en: Unsolicited High-Return Investment and Crypto Cold Call

red_flag_keywords.text: open a crypto wallet right now

scams.signals_en: Unsolicited caller pitches exclusive high-return opportunities in shares, cryptocurrency, foreign exchange, or commodities, using polished financial jargon and time-limited bonuses to force a rapid decision.
scams.legit_en: Authorised investment and financial services firms in the United Kingdom and Ireland do not cold-call members of the public with urgent high-yield offers, and legitimate firms can always be verified independently on official central bank or regulator.
bait_tactics: Right, hang on—could you spell the firm's registered name slowly so I can type it into the financial register?
My tablet battery is sitting on two percent and I can't find the charging lead anywhere in the study.
Wait a second, the page isn't loading on my mobile data—what was that firm reference number again?

CO.name: Colombia
CO.prevalence_note: Colombia 2025-2026 warnings: bank Security Impersonation and Vishing Scam; messaging Account Verification Code Takeover Scam; impersonated Relative Urgent Financial Emergency Scam; fake Phone Job Offer and Advance Fee Scam.
CO.cross_border_note: Calls in Spanish, often from other Latin American countries or from prisons.

scams.name: Suplantación telefónica de entidades bancarias (Vishing)
scams.name_en: Bank Security Impersonation and Vishing Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: número completo y código de tarjeta

scams.signals_en: Fraudsters call impersonating bank security agents or telecom representatives, using leaked personal data to build trust.
scams.legit_en: Banks across Latin America never ask customers to disclose passwords, card security codes, or dynamic verification tokens over the phone. Customers should hang up immediately and call the official bank helpline.
bait_tactics: Espéreme un momento, la aplicación del banco se quedó cargando porque en este piso casi no entra señal.
Un segundo, no tengo mis lentes a la mano y no alcanzo a ver los numeritos de la clave dinámica.
Déjeme buscar mi billetera en el otro cuarto porque no recuerdo cuál tarjeta tengo asociada ahí.

scams.name: Robo de cuenta de mensajería mediante código de verificación
scams.name_en: Messaging Account Verification Code Takeover Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pretend to be customer support, a health appointment desk, or a delivery coordinator, claiming they just sent a six-digit SMS code to confirm a booking or prevent account suspension.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate appointment desks, couriers, and messaging platforms never phone users to ask for six-digit SMS registration codes. Those verification codes are strictly private for the account holder's own device setup.
bait_tactics: No me ha llegado ningún mensaje de texto todavía, seguro hay demora en la red móvil de mi sector.
Un momentito, que mientras hablo por altavoz se me bloqueó la pantalla y no me abre la bandeja de mensajes.
Disculpe, me salieron dos mensajes viejos de la semana pasada, ¿a qué hora exacta envió el suyo?

scams.name: Cuento del tío o falso familiar en apuros económicos
scams.name_en: Impersonated Relative Urgent Financial Emergency Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: no llames a mi otro número

scams.signals_en: Scammers call pretending to be a close relative—sometimes using cloned voices or claiming a broken phone—facing an urgent car breakdown, luggage fee, or financial problem.
scams.legit_en: Genuine family emergencies across Latin America can always be verified by hanging up the phone and calling the relative's original known number, or by checking with another family member before transferring funds into unfamiliar third-party accounts.
bait_tactics: Se escucha con mucha interferencia en la línea, háblame más despacio que no distingo bien tu voz.
Espérate un ratito que el token digital del banco se me desconfiguró ayer y no me deja hacer giros.
¿En qué comisaría o taller exacto me dijiste que estás? Déjame buscar un lapicero para anotar bien.

scams.name: Estafa telefónica con falsas ofertas laborales
scams.name_en: Fake Phone Job Offer and Advance Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Unsolicited callers claim to represent recruitment agencies or international platforms offering immediate remote or part-time positions with generous daily pay.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate employers and recruitment agencies across Latin America conduct formal interviews through verified corporate channels, and they never require job candidates to pay upfront fees for certificates, exams, or task activation.
bait_tactics: Disculpe, postulé a varios avisos el mes pasado; ¿me deletrea el nombre registrado de la empresa?
Ahorita estoy sin datos móviles para abrir enlaces, deme un segundo que intento conectarme al wifi.
Espéreme un momento que mi computadora está reiniciando actualizaciones y no puedo abrir el navegador.

scams.name: Estafa telefónica bajo la modalidad del Cuento del Tío
scams.name_en: Cuento del Tio Impersonated Relative or Representative Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: entregar dólares o efectivo al contador
preparar los ahorros en un sobre

scams.signals_en: Callers pose as a grandchild, nephew, bank accountant, or lawyer claiming an urgent currency note expiration or unexpected legal fee.
scams.legit_en: Banks, public pension agencies, and legal representatives in Argentina and Uruguay never send couriers to private homes to collect cash or exchange banknotes, nor do they request secretive phone arrangements without independent family verification.
bait_tactics: Uy, aguantame un segundito que dejé la llave del cajón arriba y me cuesta subir la escalera rápido.
Se escucha re bajito por la línea, ¿me repetís cómo se llamaba el contador que decís que viene?
Esperá que justo están tocando el portero eléctrico del edificio y me fijo quién es.

scams.name: Robo de cuenta de mensajería con código de verificación
scams.name_en: Messaging Verification Code Account Takeover Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: pasame el código de seis números
código que te llegó por mensaje
confirmar el turno con el código

scams.signals_en: Impersonating public health offices, parcel couriers, or customer support, callers claim they need to confirm an appointment or delivery by asking the recipient to read aloud a six-digit SMS code just sent to their phone, enabling immediate messaging.
scams.legit_en: Public agencies, health clinics, postal services, and companies in Argentina and Uruguay never ask citizens to read out SMS verification codes during a phone call, as registration codes belong exclusively to the user.
bait_tactics: Todavía no me entró ningún mensajito de texto, acá en el fondo del departamento casi no agarra señal.
Pará que no tengo los anteojos de leer a mano y veo toda borrosa la pantalla del celular.
Disculpá, se me tildó la pantalla mientras hablábamos con el altavoz, dame un segundito.

scams.name: Falso soporte bancario o billetera virtual por operación sospechosa
scams.name_en: Fake Bank or Digital Wallet Security Officer Scam
scams.signals_en: Fraudsters claim to call from a bank or digital wallet security desk regarding a suspicious transfer or accidental loan approval.
scams.legit_en: Central Bank consumer protection guidelines in Argentina and Uruguay confirm that banks and digital wallets never ask users to share banking passwords, security tokens, phone screens, or outgoing transfers to cancel unauthorized transactions.
bait_tactics: Aguantame un cachito que la app del banco me pide reconocimiento facial y acá está medio oscuro.
Uy, me está quedando dos por ciento de batería y no encuentro dónde dejé el cargador del teléfono.
El wifi de casa anda cortándose desde hoy temprano y la ruedita del home banking gira sin abrir.

scams.name: Estafa de falsas plataformas de inversión con rendimientos garantizados
scams.name_en: Fraudulent High-Yield Investment Advisory Call Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: abonar tasa o impuesto para retirar

scams.signals_en: After luring users through online advertisements impersonating financial institutions or public figures, fake advisors phone victims promising fast, guaranteed returns.
scams.legit_en: Authorized financial intermediaries registered with national securities regulators in Argentina and Uruguay never guarantee fixed high returns via cold calls, nor do they demand separate upfront fee transfers into third-party accounts to release client funds.
bait_tactics: Pará que anoto el número de matrícula para buscarlo en el registro de valores, ¿me lo decís despacio?
Justo se me estaba hirviendo el agua para el mate en la cocina, dame un segundo que apago la hornalla.
La computadora del estudio tarda un montón en arrancar, así que todavía no me abre la página.
