BY.cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from abroad in Russian.

scams.name: Ложное «декларирование» наличных и «безопасный счёт» от лжесиловиков
scams.name_en: Fake Law Enforcement Cash Declaration and Courier Handover
scams.signals_en: Callers in messengers pose as investigators, state security, or central bank officers, often on video calls wearing uniforms.
scams.legit_en: Belarusian law enforcement agencies and the National Bank never call citizens via messengers, conduct video interrogations, demand cash declarations, ask people to take out bank loans, or send couriers to collect household savings for inspection.
bait_tactics: Секундочку, я сейчас возьму ручку на кухне, чтобы аккуратно записать номер вашего отдела.
Связь в квартире очень плохая и звук пропадает, повторите, пожалуйста, медленнее фамилию следователя.
У меня домашний интернет сегодня отключается каждые две минуты, поэтому видеосвязь не включается.

scams.name: Звонок от коммунальных служб, домофона или связи о замене и договоре
scams.name_en: Fake Utility, Intercom, or Telecom Contract Renewal Call
scams.signals_en: Callers phone landlines or messengers posing as water, electricity, intercom maintenance, clinic, or telecom staff.
scams.legit_en: Public utilities, telecom operators, polyclinics, and intercom companies in Belarus never renew contracts by requesting passport identification numbers or SMS codes over unsolicited calls;
bait_tactics: Подождите минутку, паспорт лежит где-то в дальнем шкафу с документами, сразу и не найду.
Мне пока никакое СМС не приходило, тут на первом этаже мобильная сеть еле ловит.
А сколько ключей по нашей квартире у вас записано? Сейчас поищу старую квитанцию в прихожей.

scams.name: Установка фейкового приложения банка или оператора и NFC-клонирование
scams.name_en: Fake Carrier or Bank APK Remote Access and NFC Card Theft
scams.signals_en: Posing as bank or telecom technical staff, scammers urge the victim to update their mobile app by installing an APK file sent via messenger, granting full remote screen control, or ask the victim to tap a bank card to an NFC smartphone and enter the PIN.
scams.legit_en: Belarusian banks and mobile operators publish software updates exclusively through official app channels and never send installation files in messengers, request remote-access passwords, or instruct cardholders to tap cards against smartphones and enter.
bait_tactics: Ой, у меня телефон пишет, что память заполнена и файл вообще не хочет скачиваться.
На этом старом смартфоне нет функции бесконтактной оплаты, он карточку совсем не видит.
Подождите, сейчас поставлю телефон на зарядку, а то экран потемнел и ничего не нажимается.

scams.name: Звонки лжеброкеров и кураторов фальшивых инвестиционных платформ
scams.name_en: Fake Investment Broker and Deepfake-Promoted Platform Scam
scams.signals_en: After luring victims with AI-generated celebrity or official endorsement videos, self-styled curators and brokers call repeatedly promising guaranteed passive income on fake investment or crypto platforms.
scams.legit_en: Licensed financial intermediaries in Belarus are registered with official regulators, never guarantee risk-free high returns by cold call, never urge clients to take personal loans for trading, and never demand separate advance transfers to unlock withdrawals.
bait_tactics: Подождите секунду, компьютер загружает обновления системы и браузер пока не открывается.
Продиктуйте по буквам точное юридическое название компании, чтобы я проверил его в реестре.
Я сейчас без очков не вижу реквизиты на экране, перезвоните, когда закончится обед.

EE.name: Estonia
EE.prevalence_note: Estonia 2025-2026 warnings: multi-Stage Agency and Bank Digital ID PIN Theft; fake Bank and Police Remote Access Account Takeover; fraudulent Investment Advisor and Crypto Platform Scam; fake Mobile Operator Contract Discount and Billing Scam.
EE.cross_border_note: Calls in Estonian or Russian, often from abroad.

scams.name: Mitmeastmeline riigiasutuse ja panga PIN1/PIN2 petukõne
scams.name_en: Multi-Stage Agency and Bank Digital ID PIN Theft
scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate health fund, power grid, or state portal staff in fluent Estonian or Russian, asking victims to confirm meter replacement or unused benefits with PIN1.
scams.legit_en: Estonian state agencies, utility providers, and commercial banks never initiate unsolicited phone calls asking residents to enter PIN1 or PIN2 codes, register a new digital identity device, or verify personal state portal sessions during an incoming call.
bait_tactics: Oodake hetk, mul ei tulnud ekraanile ühtegi teavitust, siin paksude seinte vahel on levi täna väga kehv.
Mu nutitelefon jooksis praegu kokku ja pilt hangus täiesti ära, pean vist seadme korraks taaskäivitama.
Ma ei leia oma lugemisprille köögist üles ega näe kontrollkoodi numbreid ekraanilt lugeda.

scams.name: Libapanga ja politsei kaughalduse ning turvakonto pettus
scams.name_en: Fake Bank and Police Remote Access Account Takeover
scams.signals_en: Fraudsters pose as bank fraud officers or police investigators claiming unauthorized loans or outgoing transfers are underway on a personal or company account.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate Estonian commercial banks and Police and Border Guard officers never conduct official fraud investigations via consumer messaging apps, never request remote desktop access to personal computers, and never instruct clients to move money into.
bait_tactics: Mul on vana sülearvuti alles uuendusi paigaldamas ja ekraanil näitab alles kahtteist protsenti.
Siin arvutis nõuab programm administraatori parooli, mille mu pereliige pani ja mida ma peast ei mäleta.
Kõne hakib praegu tugevalt, korrake palun aeglaselt oma osakonna ja uurija nime, ma otsin pastaka.

scams.name: Libamaakleri ja krüptoraha investeerimisplatvormi pettus
scams.name_en: Fraudulent Investment Advisor and Crypto Platform Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers claiming to be financial brokers follow up on online ads or deepfake celebrity endorsements, promising low-risk high returns in cryptocurrency, stocks, or bonds.
scams.legit_en: Licensed investment firms operating in Estonia are strictly supervised by the Estonian Financial Supervision Authority, never guarantee risk-free returns during unsolicited phone calls, and never ask clients to take consumer loans or pay advance fees for.
bait_tactics: Oodake korraks, ma proovin finantsinspektsiooni lehelt teie tegevusloa numbrit üles otsida, kuidas see täht-tähelt käib?
Mul on pangas päevalimiit nulli keeratud ja ID-kaardi lugeja jäi töö juurde laua peale.
Internet ruuteris jälle jupsib, veebileht lihtsalt ketrab ega lae ühtegi vormi ära.

scams.name: Libamobiilioperaatori lepingupikenduse ja sooduspaketi pettus
scams.name_en: Fake Mobile Operator Contract Discount and Billing Scam
scams.signals_en: Using local prepaid SIM-boxes to display genuine domestic numbers, scammers pose as mobile carrier representatives offering steep package discounts, SIM upgrades, or warning of unpaid invoices.
scams.legit_en: Estonian mobile network operators manage all plan changes, monthly invoices, and contract renewals inside their official self-service portals and never ask subscribers to dictate card details or approve unexpected banking PIN prompts during cold calls.
bait_tactics: Oot-oot, ma kohe vaatan paberarve pealt järgi, aga ma ei leia sahtlist eelmise kuu kausta üles.
Iseteeninduse leht annab mulle praegu mingit veateadet ega lase sisse logida.
Uksekell just helises, kuller on vist ukse taga—rääkige korraks uuesti, mis paketist jutt oli?

LV.name: Latvia
LV.prevalence_note: Latvia 2025-2026 warnings: fake Courier and Institution Digital ID PIN Phishing; multi-Call Telecom, e-Signature, and Central Bank Impersonation; fake Police Cash and Bank Card Courier Pickup Scam; fake Investment Broker and Trading Platform Scam.
LV.cross_border_note: Calls in Latvian or Russian, often from abroad.

scams.name: Viltus kurjera vai iestādes digitālās identifikācijas PIN1/PIN2 izkrāpšana
scams.name_en: Fake Courier and Institution Digital ID PIN Phishing
scams.signals_en: Scammers call posing as parcel couriers or public agency staff to trick victims into entering PIN1 for identity verification.
scams.legit_en: CERT.LV confirms that Latvian commercial banks, parcel couriers, and state authorities never call citizens in Russian, never ask residents to reveal or enter digital authentication PIN codes during incoming calls, and never collect money for safe custody.
bait_tactics: Pagaidiet mirklīti, man telefonā neparādījās neviens logs, laikam interneta zona te pagrabstāvā pazuda.
Ekrāns tikko sasala un lietotne vispār neatveras, man jāatrod lādētājs otrā istabā.
Es bez lasāmbrillēm neredzu tos mazos ciparus ekrānā, tūlīt paskatīšos, kur es tās noliku.

scams.name: Daudzpakāpju sakaru operatora, e-paraksta un centrālās bankas krāpšana
scams.name_en: Multi-Call Telecom, e-Signature, and Central Bank Impersonation
scams.signals_en: Victims receive rapid back-to-back calls from fraudsters impersonating mobile operators, national electronic signature support, and central bank or police officials.
scams.legit_en: Latvian mobile network operators, the State Radio and Television Centre, the Bank of Latvia, and State Police never chain-transfer citizens between institutions during a phone call or demand urgent mobile signature approvals over unsolicited calls.
bait_tactics: Sakari šobrīd ļoti raustās, vai varat pa burtiem lēnām nosaukt savu nodaļu, kamēr es meklēju pildspalvu?
Man elektroniskā paraksta lietotne prasa atjauninājumu un rāda, ka jāgaida desmit minūtes.
Pagaidiet, es neatceros savu līguma numuru no galvas, tūlīt pameklēšu papīra mapi plauktā.

scams.name: Viltus policijas un kurjera skaidras naudas vai bankas kartes izkrāpšana
scams.name_en: Fake Police Cash and Bank Card Courier Pickup Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers impersonating State Police or tax investigators claim the victim's bank account is compromised or that home savings must be inspected for counterfeit banknotes.
scams.legit_en: Latvian State Police officers, State Revenue Service inspectors, and commercial banks never dispatch couriers to private homes to collect cash or payment cards, and never ask citizens to deposit bank cards inside parcel lockers.
bait_tactics: Uzgaidiet, mūsu kāpņutelpas durvju kods šodien nestrādā, un suns pagalmā skaļi rej, es slikti dzirdu.
Man bankas karte palika makā darba jakā, un es vispār neatceros, kurš PIN kods tai bija.
Pagaidiet minūti, tējkanna uz plīts sāk svilpt, tūlīt nogriezīšu uguni un pierakstīšu lietas numuru.

scams.name: Viltus investīciju brokeru un tirdzniecības platformu krāpšana
scams.name_en: Fake Investment Broker and Trading Platform Scam
scams.signals_en: Self-proclaimed investment analysts call persistently after social media ads, persuading residents to make initial small transfers into fake stock or crypto platforms showing fabricated profits.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate investment service providers in Latvia must hold an active license registered with Latvijas Banka, never promise guaranteed rapid returns over cold calls, and never demand separate advance transfers to release existing investor balances.
bait_tactics: Pagaidiet, es mēģinu Latvijas Bankas mājaslapā atvērt licencēto brokeru sarakstu, bet lapa lēni ielādējas.
Mans dators tikko sāka instalēt sistēmas atjauninājumus un neļauj atvērt pārlūkprogrammu.
Nosauciet lēnām pa burtiem uzņēmuma reģistrācijas numuru, man pildspalva gandrīz vairs neraksta.

LT.name: Lithuania
LT.prevalence_note: Lithuania 2025-2026 warnings: fake Bank and Police Investigation Digital PIN Theft; fake Relative Emergency and Doorstep Card Courier Scam; second-Pillar Pension Withdrawal and State Agency Impersonation; fake Investment Trading and Secondary Fund Recovery Scam.
LT.cross_border_note: Calls in Lithuanian or Russian, often from abroad.

scams.name: Sukčių skambučiai apsimetus banko ar policijos darbuotojais (PIN1/PIN2)
scams.name_en: Fake Bank and Police Investigation Digital PIN Theft
scams.signals_en: Callers impersonate bank security officers, police, or financial crime investigators—either starting in broken Lithuanian before switching to Russian or using fluent AI-assisted Lithuanian.
scams.legit_en: Lithuania's Communications Regulatory Authority and the Lithuanian Banking Association confirm that commercial banks and law enforcement officers never ask citizens to dictate login passwords or enter mobile authentication PIN codes during unsolicited.
bait_tactics: Palaukite minutėlę, man programėlėje jokia užklausa neatsirado, gal mobilusis internetas rūsyje trūkinėja.
Telefonas kažko visai pakibo ir neatidaro banko lango, tuoj pamėginsiu perkrauti ekraną.
Aš be skaitymo akinių neįžiūriu smulkių skaičių ekrane, tuoj paieškosiu jų svetainėje.

scams.name: Sukčiavimas apsimetus į avariją patekusiu artimuoju arba banko kurjeriu
scams.name_en: Fake Relative Emergency and Doorstep Card Courier Scam
scams.signals_en: Targeting older residents in particular, scammers either claim a close family member caused a traffic accident requiring urgent cash for medical or legal settlement, or pose as bank staff claiming an unsafe payment card must be collected at the doorstep.
scams.legit_en: Lithuanian police investigators, public hospital physicians, and commercial banks never dispatch couriers to private residences to collect cash settlements, retrieve existing payment cards, or request secret card PIN codes from citizens under any.
bait_tactics: Oi, labai prastai girdžiu per traškesį, pakartokite lėčiau, kurioje tiksliai ligoninėje ar gatvėje tai įvyko?
Palaukite sekundę, laiptinės domofonas pas mus šiandien sugedęs ir durys iš apačios neatsidaro.
Mano piniginė su kortele liko užrakinta kitame kambaryje, tuoj paieškosiu, kur padėjau raktelį.

scams.name: Sukčiavimas prisidengus pensijų fondo išmokomis, mokesčiais ar paštu
scams.name_en: Second-Pillar Pension Withdrawal and State Agency Impersonation
scams.signals_en: Exploiting 2026 second-pillar pension fund withdrawals and seasonal tax filings, scammers impersonate social insurance, tax, or postal staff via calls and messages.
scams.legit_en: Official Lithuanian tax authorities, social insurance offices, and national postal services process citizen applications exclusively through verified government portals and never phone residents to redirect pension fund payouts into external third-party.
bait_tactics: Palaukite, mano kompiuteris labai lėtai jungiasi, dar neatidarė savitarnos puslapio patikrinimui.
Tuoj susirasiu tušinuką virtuvėje, padiktuokite lėtai rašto registracijos numerį.
Šiandien namų internetas vis atsijunginėja, jokia nuoroda telefone neužsikrauna.

scams.name: Investicinės platformos ir netikro prarastų lėšų susigrąžinimo sukčiavimas
scams.name_en: Fake Investment Trading and Secondary Fund Recovery Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pitch high-yield stock or crypto trading platforms and coach victims into repeated bank transfers.
scams.legit_en: Neither the Bank of Lithuania, the Lithuanian Police, nor the National Cyber Security Centre ever charge citizens advance fees to recover defrauded funds, and licensed investment brokers never make cold calls promising guaranteed profits.
bait_tactics: Luktelėkite, bandau Lietuvos banko sąraše suvesti jūsų įmonės pavadinimą, kaip tiksliai jis rašomas?
Mano telefone baigiasi baterija, liko vos du procentai, tuoj paieškosiu įkroviklio.
Pavedimų limitas mano sąskaitoje dabar nustatytas nulinis, be generatoriaus jo nepakeisiu.

LB.name: Lebanon
LB.prevalence_note: Lebanon 2025-2026 warnings: bank and Salary Card Verification Scam; messaging Account Verification Code Hijacking; fake Traffic Fine and Customs Fee Impersonation; fake Trading Platform and Daily Task Investment Scam.
LB.cross_border_note: Calls in Arabic, sometimes from neighbouring countries.

scams.name: انتحال صفة المصارف ومكاتب بطاقات الرواتب والمحافظ الإلكترونية
scams.name_en: Bank and Salary Card Verification Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller claims to represent a central bank, commercial bank, electronic wallet provider, or state salary card office.
scams.legit_en: Central banks in the region do not manage retail accounts or call citizens directly. Licensed banks and electronic wallet operators never ask customers to read out full card numbers, PINs, or SMS verification codes over the phone to unlock accounts.
bait_tactics: لحظة من فضلك، الرسائل النصية تتأخر بالوصول إلى هاتفي بسبب ضعف التغطية داخل المبنى الآن.
البطاقة المصرفية موجودة في حقيبتي بالغرفة الأخرى، انتظر قليلاً ريثما أبحث عن نظارتي أيضاً.
التطبيق المالي على هاتفي يطلب تحديثاً بطيئاً ولا يفتح الشاشة حالياً لأن الإنترنت متقطع.

scams.name: سرقة حسابات المراسلة الفورية عبر طلب رمز التفعيل
scams.name_en: Messaging Account Verification Code Hijacking
scams.signals_en: Caller claims they accidentally sent an SMS registration code to your phone number, or invites you into a community or event group requiring verification.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate group invitations and messaging platforms never require sharing an SMS login code with another person. Any six-digit registration code arriving on your phone authorizes full account takeover on a new device and must remain strictly private.
bait_tactics: مهلاً، شاشة الهاتف أغلقت أثناء المكالمة ولا تفتح قائمة الرسائل النصية في هذه اللحظة.
لم تصلني أي رسالة جديدة حتى الآن، الشبكة ضعيفة جداً هنا عندما ينقطع التيار.
وصلتني رسالتان قديمتان منذ يوم أمس فقط، في أي دقيقة بالضبط أرسلت الرمز؟

scams.name: احتيال مخالفات السير والرسوم الجمركية الوهمية
scams.name_en: Fake Traffic Fine and Customs Fee Impersonation
scams.signals_en: Caller or follow-up voice prompt impersonates internal security forces, traffic authorities, or customs offices regarding an unpaid radar speeding ticket or held postal shipment.
scams.legit_en: Official traffic penalties and customs duties in Levant countries are processed strictly through authorized postal offices, licensed payment counters, or verified government portals.
bait_tactics: انتظر قليلاً ريثما أحضر أوراق المركبة من الدرج لأطابق رقم اللوحة وتاريخ المخالفة.
المتصفح على هاتفي بطيء جداً ولا يفتح أي رابط خارجي بسبب نفاد حزمة الإنترنت.
عفواً، الصوت يتقطع بسبب الضوضاء في الشارع، هل يمكنك قراءة رقم الإشعار ببطء لأكتبه؟

scams.name: منصات التداول الوهمية والمهام اليومية المربحة
scams.name_en: Fake Trading Platform and Daily Task Investment Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller pitches an online trading platform or app-based daily task program promising rapid, guaranteed returns from a small initial deposit.
scams.legit_en: Regulated financial brokerages in Levant jurisdictions must hold verifiable central bank or securities commission licenses, never guarantee fixed daily profits, and distribute mobile apps exclusively through official app stores without demanding advance.
bait_tactics: مساحة التخزين في هاتفي ممتلئة تماماً ولا يسمح بتنزيل أي تطبيق جديد حالياً.
أمهلني دقيقة لأبحث عن قلم وأكتب رقم ترخيص الشركة للتحقق منه في السجل الرسمي.
بطارية الهاتف أوشكت على النفاد ولا أجد الشاحن في المكتب الآن.

JO.name: Jordan
JO.prevalence_note: Jordan 2025-2026 warnings: bank and Salary Card Verification Scam; messaging Account Verification Code Hijacking; fake Traffic Fine and Customs Fee Impersonation; fake Trading Platform and Daily Task Investment Scam.

MA.name: Morocco

MA.cross_border_note: Calls in Arabic or French, often from foreign numbers.

scams.name: انتحال صفة مستشار البنك أو التعاضدية لطلب الرمز السري
scams.name_en: Bank and Mutual Insurance Advisor OTP Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller poses as a bank advisor, central bank security agent, or mutual health insurance representative claiming an urgent account update, refund, or suspicious card charge.
scams.legit_en: Central banks, commercial banks, and mutual insurance funds across Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia explicitly state that legitimate staff never ask clients by phone or SMS for secret confirmation codes, online banking passwords, or payment card security numbers.
bait_tactics: لحظة من فضلكم، لم أتوصل بأي رسالة نصية على الهاتف حتى الآن بسبب ضعف التغطية داخل المنزل.
البطاقة البنكية تركتها في سترتي بالطابق العلوي، انتظروا قليلاً ريثما أصعد لإحضارها.
تطبيق البنك على هاتفي يطلب تحديثاً جديداً ويدور ببطء شديد بسبب ضعف شبكة الواي فاي.

scams.name: الاحتيال باسم تطبيقات الدفع البريدي والبطاقة البريدية
scams.name_en: Postal Financial App and Smart Card Takeover Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller impersonates national postal service staff or marketplace buyers using postal mobile payment apps in Algeria, Tunisia, or Morocco.
scams.legit_en: National postal institutions in North Africa never telephone account holders to request SMS verification codes, card expiration dates, or app login credentials. Incoming transfers require only a public postal account identifier, never a one-time security code.
bait_tactics: التطبيق البريدي متوقف على شاشة التحميل الآن ولا يعرض أي إشعارات، أمهلوني دقيقة.
الشريحة التي تستقبل رسائل البريد موجودة في هاتفي القديم وهو فارغ الشحن حالياً.
لا أرى الأرقام الصغيرة على الشاشة بدون نظارة القراءة، سأبحث عنها في غرفة الجلوس.

scams.name: احتيال المخالفات المرورية والطرود البريدية المعلقة
scams.name_en: Fake Unpaid Traffic Fine and Foreign Notification Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers contact citizens from foreign or spoofed numbers claiming an unpaid traffic violation or a blocked postal delivery requiring immediate fee settlement.
scams.legit_en: Official traffic fine and public administration services in Maghreb states operate exclusively on verified national government domains or physical treasury offices, never sending payment links from foreign mobile numbers or requesting card PINs over the phone.
bait_tactics: انتظروا لحظة ريثما أبحث عن وثائق السيارة في الدرج لأتحقق من رقم التسجيل وتاريخ المخالفة.
رصيد الإنترنت على هاتفي انتهى هذا الصباح ولا تفتح معي أي صفحة دفع إلكتروني.
هل يمكنكم قراءة رقم المحضر ببطء شديد؟ القلم الذي بيدي بالكاد يكتب.

scams.name: احتيال الفوز بجوائز مالية أو تذاكر مباريات كبرى
scams.name_en: Fake Tournament Ticket and Brand Prize Lottery Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller announces that the recipient won cash, electronics, or major football tournament tickets in a promotional draw.
scams.legit_en: Genuine commercial contests and official tournament ticket platforms in North Africa never notify random non-participants of surprise cash prizes by phone, nor do they charge advance processing fees or request card security codes to award prizes.
bait_tactics: يا سلام، ولكن أي مسابقة تقصدون بالضبط؟ دعوني أسأل أفراد العائلة إن كان أحدهم سجل رقمي.
جرس الباب يرن الآن بسبب عامل التوصيل، انتظروا لحظة وأعيدوا لي تفاصيل الجائزة.
بطاقتي البنكية منتهية الصلاحية منذ الشهر الماضي ولم أستلم البطاقة الجديدة من الوكالة بعد.

scams.name: کلاهبرداری ثبت اعتراض به حذف کالابرگ الکترونیکی و یارانه معیشتی
scams.name_en: Fake Electronic Voucher and Livelihood Subsidy Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller or message claims your household cash subsidy or electronic food voucher is being cut or awaits retroactive deposit.
scams.legit_en: Official livelihood subsidies and electronic vouchers in Iran are announced strictly through verified government sender IDs such as YARANEH-IRI and official ministry portals, without telephoning citizens for bank card CVV2 numbers, dynamic passwords, or.
bait_tactics: ببخشید یک لحظه، کیف پولم که کارت یارانه داخلش است در اتاق دیگر جا مانده، الان پیدایش می‌کنم.
پیامک رمز پویا به خاطر ضعیف بودن آنتن داخل ساختمان هنوز برای من نیامده است.
گوشی من حافظه‌اش کاملاً پر شده و اجازه باز کردن لینک یا نصب هیچ برنامه‌ای را نمی‌دهد.

scams.name: کلاهبرداری ابلاغیه قضایی جعلی سامانه ثنا و جعل عنوان پلیس فتا
scams.name_en: Fake Judicial Summons and Cyber Police Impersonation
scams.signals_en: Caller adopts a stern official tone claiming to be a cyber police officer or judicial clerk investigating a suspicious bank transaction or newly filed complaint.
scams.legit_en: Iranian police and judicial authorities never issue arrest threats by phone or send clickable payment links in messaging apps.
bait_tactics: یک لحظه اجازه بدهید عینک مطالعه‌ام را پیدا کنم تا شماره پرونده را روی کاغذ یادداشت کنم.
اینترنت خط من الان قطع و وصل می‌شود و هیچ صفحه‌ای روی مرورگر گوشی باز نمی‌شود.
ببخشید صدای خط خش‌خش دارد، می‌شود نام شعبه و کد پیگیری را شمرده‌تر بفرمایید؟

scams.name: کلاهبرداری برنده شدن در قرعه‌کشی اپراتورها و مسابقات تلفنی
scams.name_en: Fake Mobile Operator and Contest Prize Lottery Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller congratulates the recipient on winning tens of millions of tomans or home appliances in a mobile operator or media draw for active SIM cards.
scams.legit_en: Iranian mobile operators announce draw winners only through official customer numbers such as 9990 and verified portals. Transferring cash prizes requires at most a public IBAN or card number, never an ATM visit, OTP code, or delivery fee.
bait_tactics: چه جالب، فقط من شماره شبای حسابم را از حفظ نیستم، بگذارید دفترچه بانک را در کمد بگردم.
هنوز هیچ پیامکی روی گوشی من نیامده، شاید سیم‌کارت دومم در تنظیمات غیرفعال شده باشد.
الان کتری روی گاز سوت می‌کشد، یک ثانیه صبر کنید زیرش را کم کنم و برگردم.

scams.name: کلاهبرداری مسدودی حساب بانکی و سرقت رمز دوم پویا
scams.name_en: Bank Account Security Freeze and Dynamic PIN Scam
scams.signals_en: Caller uses simulated call-center background noise and recites leaked personal details while claiming to be bank security staff.
scams.legit_en: Banks operating under Central Bank of Iran regulations never ask customers over the phone for CVV2 codes, card expiration dates, or dynamic OTP passwords. Account unblocking is handled exclusively through official banking apps or in-person branch visits.
bait_tactics: گوشی ساده دکمه‌ای که پیامک‌های بانک رویش می‌آید الان خاموش است و شارژرش را پیدا نمی‌کنم.
اعداد پشت کارت بانکی من در اثر استفاده زیاد پاک شده و خوانا نیست، یک لحظه صبر کنید.
برنامه همراه بانک خطای به‌روزرسانی می‌دهد و اصلاً وارد صفحه کارت‌ها نمی‌شود.

AZ.name: Azerbaijan
AZ.prevalence_note: Azerbaijan 2025-2026 warnings: fake Bank Cyber-Intrusion and Card Security Alert Scam; fake Postal Parcel Address Update and Fee Phishing Scam; high-Pay Remote Job and Bank Card Money-Mule Recruitment Scam; fake State Energy Bond and High-Yield Investment Platform Scam.
AZ.cross_border_note: Calls in Azerbaijani or Russian, sometimes from abroad.

scams.name: Saxta bank təhlükəsizlik xidməti və kibermüdaxilə zəngləri
scams.name_en: Fake Bank Cyber-Intrusion and Card Security Alert Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers or video callers impersonate bank security specialists claiming a cyber-intrusion or suspicious transfer was detected on the recipient's card.
scams.legit_en: Real banks in Azerbaijan block suspicious card transactions automatically and never ask customers over phone or video calls for full card numbers, PINs, CVV codes, or SMS one-time passwords.
bait_tactics: Bir dəqiqə gözləyin, pulqabım və kartım digər otaqda çantada qalıb, indi gedib baxıram.
Telefonuma hələ heç bir təsdiq mesajı gəlməyib, binanın içində şəbəkə çox zəif tutur.
Mobil tətbiq yeniləmə tələb edir və ekran fırlanır, hələ heç nə açılmır.

scams.name: Poçt bağlaması ünvan yeniləməsi və saxta ödəniş keçidi dələduzluğu
scams.name_en: Fake Postal Parcel Address Update and Fee Phishing Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers contact citizens from foreign or spoofed numbers via phone and messaging apps, claiming an inbound parcel cannot be delivered due to incomplete address details or unpaid delivery charges.
scams.legit_en: Official postal services in Azerbaijan notify recipients through verified tracking channels and collect any applicable customs or delivery fees at official post branches or verified government portals, never via links sent from foreign mobile numbers.
bait_tactics: Gözləyin, eynəyimi tapım ki, göndərdiyiniz izləmə nömrəsini vərəqə dəqiq yaza bilim.
Mənim mobil internet paketim bu gün bitib, ona görə heç bir xarici keçid açılmır.
Qapının zəngi çalınır, deyəsən qonşudur—bağlamanın hansı ölkədən gəldiyini bir də təkrar edərsiniz?

scams.name: Yüksək maaşlı uzaqdan iş adı ilə bank kartı icarəsi dələduzluğu
scams.name_en: High-Pay Remote Job and Bank Card Money-Mule Recruitment Scam
scams.signals_en: Recruiters call or message applicants promising high-paying, effortless online work managing financial transfers from home.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate employers in Azerbaijan sign formal employment contracts registered through the state electronic labor system and pay salaries to the employee's own IBAN account.
bait_tactics: Şirkətin vergi uçot nömrəsini hərflərlə yavaş-yavaş deyin, qələmim yaxşı yazmır.
Mənim köhnə maaş kartımın müddəti keçən ay bitib, hələ yenisini bankdan götürməmişəm.
Kompüterim hazırda yenilənir və elektron əmək portalını aça bilmirəm, bir az gözləyin.

scams.name: Dövlət neft və istiqraz layihələri adı altında saxta investisiya
scams.name_en: Fake State Energy Bond and High-Yield Investment Platform Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as investment advisors representing national energy projects or major banks after victims click social media ads.
scams.legit_en: Licensed investment companies and bond offerings in Azerbaijan are regulated by the Central Bank and traded via the Baku Stock Exchange through authorized banks.
bait_tactics: Bir saniyə, çaydan qaynayır, mətbəxə keçib ocağı söndürüm, sonra lisenziya nömrəsini yazaram.
Telefonumun enerjisi iki faizə düşüb, indi şarj cihazını axtarıram ki, sönməsin.
Evdəki Wi-Fi modemi sönüb-yanır, heç bir qeydiyyat səhifəsi açılmır.

AM.name: Armenia
AM.prevalence_note: Armenia 2025-2026 warnings: fake Telecom 5G Upgrade and Screen-Sharing Remote Access Scam; fake Pension Fund Recalculation and Account Freeze Scam; forged Central Bank Document and Unauthorized Online Loan Scam; unlicensed Investment Brokerage and Fake Securities Offer Scam.
AM.cross_border_note: Calls in Armenian or Russian, sometimes from abroad.

scams.name: Օպերատորի անվան տակ 5G ակտիվացման և էկրանի համօգտագործման խաբեություն
scams.name_en: Fake Telecom 5G Upgrade and Screen-Sharing Remote Access Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers call citizens via messaging apps or mobile networks posing as telecom technical specialists offering to improve mobile internet quality or activate 5G service.
scams.legit_en: Mobile operators in Armenia configure network upgrades automatically or through standard device settings and official service centers.
bait_tactics: Մի վայրկյան սպասեք, հեռախոսիս հիշողությունը լրիվ լցված է և ոչ մի ֆայլ չի ներբեռնվում։
Կարգավորումների մենյուն կախվել է, իսկ մարտկոցը համարյա նստում է, գնամ լիցքավորիչը գտնեմ։
Այստեղ ինտերնետը շատ թույլ է աշխատում, էկրանին ոչ մի կոճակ չի բացվում հիմա։

scams.name: Կենսաթոշակի վերահաշվարկի և պետական մարմինների անունից խարդախություն
scams.name_en: Fake Pension Fund Recalculation and Account Freeze Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers use spoofed numbers to impersonate state agencies or pension fund managers, claiming an error was found during pension recalculation.
scams.legit_en: Armenian pension funds and state social agencies never resolve benefit recalculations or overpayments by phone, never demand urgent data verification over unsolicited calls, and never ask citizens for bank card numbers, CVV codes, or SMS one-time passwords.
bait_tactics: Սպասեք մի րոպե, ակնոցս մյուս սենյակում է մնացել, առանց դրա հաղորդագրությունը չեմ կարող կարդալ։
Թոշակի քարտս ու անձնագիրս պահարանի վերևի դարակում են, հիմա փորձեմ գտնել թղթապանակը։
Հեռախոսիս դեռ ոչ մի կարճ հաղորդագրություն չի եկել, երևի կապի խնդիր կա մեր թաղամասում։

scams.name: Կենտրոնական բանկի կեղծ փաստաթղթերով և օնլայն վարկերով խաբեություն
scams.name_en: Forged Central Bank Document and Unauthorized Online Loan Scam
scams.signals_en: Fraudsters contact victims claiming fraudulent loans are being opened in their name and present forged certificates or powers of attorney purportedly issued by the Central Bank of Armenia.
scams.legit_en: The Central Bank of Armenia does not call individual citizens to manage personal accounts or issue powers of attorney for routine customer banking. Commercial banks verify identity only when customers contact official hotlines or visit branches in person.
bait_tactics: Բանկային հավելվածս հիմա թարմացում է պահանջում և ընդհանրապես չի մտնում իմ էջ։
Մի պահ համբերեք, գրիչ գտնեմ խոհանոցում, որ այդ տեղեկանքի համարը գրի առնեմ։
Ձայնը շատ է կտրտվում, կարո՞ղ եք դանդաղ կրկնել՝ որ բաժնից եք զանգահարում։

scams.name: Չլիցենզավորված ներդրումային հարթակների և բարձր եկամտի խաբեություն
scams.name_en: Unlicensed Investment Brokerage and Fake Securities Offer Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers represent unlicensed investment brands or fake credit companies, pitching high-yield securities or rapid-return portfolios over phone calls and social media ads.
scams.legit_en: Public securities offerings and investment services in Armenia require licensing and registered prospectuses published on the Central Bank of Armenia official website.
bait_tactics: Համակարգիչս դեռ նոր է միանում, մի րոպե սպասեք, որ բացեմ լիցենզավորված ընկերությունների ցանկը։
Դռան զանգը տվեցին, երևի առաքիչն է եկել, մի վայրկյանից կվերադառնամ, կրկնեք ընկերության անունը։
Քարտիս օրական փոխանցման սահմանաչափը զրոյացված է, առանց մասնաճյուղ գնալու չի փոխվում։

GE.name: Georgia
GE.prevalence_note: Georgia 2025-2026 warnings: fake Bank Representative Security Procedure and Online Loan Scam; fake National Bank of Georgia Officials Phone and Messaging Scam; fake Investment Brokerage Call-Center and Financial Pyramid Scam; fake Postal Courier Parcel Fee and Card Phishing Scam.
GE.cross_border_note: Calls in Georgian or Russian, often over WhatsApp or from abroad.

scams.name: ბანკის უსაფრთხოების სამსახურის სახელით ერთჯერადი კოდისა და სესხის თაღლითობა
scams.name_en: Fake Bank Representative Security Procedure and Online Loan Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as commercial bank representatives claiming the customer must complete urgent security procedures to stop unauthorized account activity.
scams.legit_en: Commercial banks in Georgia never call customers to ask for internet or mobile banking usernames, passwords, full card numbers, CVV codes, or SMS one-time passwords. Customers should always verify alerts through the bank's official hotline or mobile app.
bait_tactics: ერთი წუთით მოითმინეთ, მობილბანკის აპლიკაცია განახლებას მთხოვს და ეკრანი გაჭედილია.
სათვალე მეორე ოთახში დამრჩა და ტელეფონის ეკრანზე წვრილ ციფრებს ვერ ვარჩევ.
ტელეფონზე ჯერ არანაირი მოკლე შეტყობინება არ მოსულა, აქ შენობაში მიღება ძალიან სუსტია.

scams.name: ეროვნული ბანკის თანამშრომლის სახელით განხორციელებული თაღლითური ზარები
scams.name_en: Fake National Bank of Georgia Officials Phone and Messaging Scam
scams.signals_en: Unknown callers contact citizens via phone and messaging platforms like WhatsApp claiming to represent the National Bank of Georgia.
scams.legit_en: Under Georgian law, the National Bank of Georgia does not service personal retail accounts or assist individuals in obtaining commercial bank products.
bait_tactics: მოიცადეთ, კალამს მოვძებნი სამზარეულოში, რომ თქვენი დეპარტამენტის სახელი ზუსტად ჩავიწერო.
ჩემი სახლის ინტერნეტი დღეს სულ ითიშება და არცერთი ბმული ბრაუზერში არ იხსნება.
ხმა ძალიან წყდება ხაზზე, შეგიძლიათ ნელა გამიმეოროთ განცხადების რეგისტრაციის ნომერი?

scams.name: ყალბი საბროკერო კომპანიებისა და ფინანსური პირამიდების ზარები
scams.name_en: Fake Investment Brokerage Call-Center and Financial Pyramid Scam
scams.signals_en: Fraudulent call-center agents contact citizens using corporate titles containing words like brokerage, financial, or investment to appear regulated.
scams.legit_en: Incorporating financial or brokerage terms in a company name does not mean an entity is licensed in Georgia. Citizens should verify supervision status directly on the National Bank of Georgia registry before investing any funds.
bait_tactics: ერთი წამით, კომპიუტერი ახლახან ჩავრთე და სისტემა ძალიან ნელა იტვირთება.
ასო-ასო მიკარნახეთ კომპანიის დასახელება, რომ ეროვნული ბანკის რეესტრში მოვძებნო.
ტელეფონის ელემენტი თითქმის დაჯდა, დამტენს შევაერთებ და მითხარით რა პირობაა.

scams.name: საფოსტო გზავნილის მისამართის დაზუსტებისა და ყალბი გადახდის თაღლითობა
scams.name_en: Fake Postal Courier Parcel Fee and Card Phishing Scam
scams.signals_en: Scammers impersonate postal or courier services via calls and text messages, claiming an incoming parcel is stalled due to an invalid street address or small unpaid delivery fee.
scams.legit_en: Official Georgian postal and courier operators allow parcel tracking on verified domains using tracking numbers and never ask recipients over phone calls or text links to enter online banking passwords or card CVV codes.
bait_tactics: უკაცრავად, კარზე კურიერმა ან მეზობელმა დარეკა, ერთ წამს გავიხედავ და გზავნილის კოდს ჩავიწერ.
საფულე მანქანაში დამრჩა და ზეპირად ბარათის ნომერი ნამდვილად არ მახსოვს.
მობილური ინტერნეტის პაკეტი ამომეწურა და გადახდის გვერდი საერთოდ არ იხსნება.

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.prevalence_note: South Africa 2025-2026 warnings: bank Fraud Department & SIM-Swap OTP Vishing; iCASA & SAPS Criminal Warrant Impersonation Scam; sARS Tax Refund Audit & Outstanding Debt Scam; sARS Customs Suspicious Parcel Impersonation Scam.
ZA.cross_border_note: Calls in English or Afrikaans, often from local numbers.

scams.name: Bank Fraud Department & SIM-Swap OTP Vishing Scam
scams.name_en: Bank Fraud Department & SIM-Swap OTP Vishing
scams.signals_en: Caller poses as a bank fraud investigator warning of an unauthorised transaction or pending SIM swap, already quoting leaked personal details to build trust.
scams.legit_en: South African banks never ask customers to share a PIN, password, one-time PIN, or verification code over the phone, nor instruct clients to transfer funds into a separate safe account.
bait_tactics: Hang on a second, our inverter just clicked over and the home Wi-Fi is rebooting, so my banking app won't open.
Wait a bit, no one-time PIN text has come through yet—cell signal on this side of the house is terrible.
Sorry, my reading glasses are in the study and I can't read the small pop-up message on my screen.

scams.name: ICASA & SAPS Criminal Warrant Impersonation Scam
scams.name_en: ICASA & SAPS Criminal Warrant Impersonation Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: transferring you to a police officer

scams.signals_en: Caller claims to represent the telecommunications regulator or a network fraud desk, alleging the victim's mobile number or identity number was used in money laundering or illegal SIM registrations and faces disconnection within hours.
scams.legit_en: Neither South Africa's communications regulator nor the police phone citizens to threaten sudden SIM deactivation, transfer calls directly to investigating officers, or request banking credentials and clearance payments.
bait_tactics: Hold on, let me find a pen in the kitchen drawer so I can write down that case docket number properly.
Sorry, the dogs are barking right at the front gate for a courier—could you repeat which station you said?
My green ID book is locked away in the safe upstairs and I don't have the keys on me right now.

scams.name: SARS Tax Refund Audit & Outstanding Debt Scam
scams.name_en: SARS Tax Refund Audit & Outstanding Debt Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: deposit into this account to avoid arrest
click the link to release your refund

scams.signals_en: Scammers impersonate revenue service officials during filing season, claiming a substantial tax refund is on hold under audit or threatening immediate penalties and arrest over fabricated tax arrears.
scams.legit_en: The South African Revenue Service pays verified refunds automatically into the registered bank account on file and never phones taxpayers to ask for passwords, banking PINs, or payments to personal accounts.
bait_tactics: Wait a second, my laptop is taking forever to boot up so I can't open my tax filing profile yet.
My bookkeeper changed my tax portal password during filing season and I don't have it written down here.
The line is breaking up badly—could you slowly read out the assessment reference number again?

scams.name: Customs Inspector Flagged Parcel Extortion Scam
scams.name_en: SARS Customs Suspicious Parcel Impersonation Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: transferring your call to the police

scams.signals_en: Fraudsters call pretending to be customs inspectors, reciting leaked names and identity numbers while claiming an international parcel in the target's name was intercepted with illegal documents or narcotics.
scams.legit_en: Customs officials in South Africa do not phone individuals to demand personal data, solicit payments, or transfer calls to police officers over detained shipments.
bait_tactics: Hold on, which airport depot did you say that parcel is sitting at? Let me grab a notepad.
My mobile data bundle just ran out so I can't load any tracking link while we're on this call.
Wait a minute, my phone battery is on two percent—let me quickly plug it into the wall.

KE.name: Kenya
KE.prevalence_note: Kenya 2025-2026 warnings: east Africa Fake Mobile Money Credit & Reversal Scam; false Medical Emergency & Acquaintance Impersonation Scam.
KE.cross_border_note: Calls in Swahili, Amharic, French or English, often from local mobile numbers.

scams.name: Utapeli wa kutuma pesa kimakosa na kuomba urudishe (East Africa Mobile Money)
scams.name_en: East Africa Fake Mobile Money Credit & Reversal Scam

red_flag_keywords.text: ile fedha tuma kwenye namba hii

scams.signals_en: Scammers send a forged confirmation SMS from an ordinary mobile number or push a reversible transfer, then call in panic claiming they sent hospital or school money to the wrong recipient.

scams.name: Arnaque à la désactivation du portefeuille mobile et frais de déblocage
scams.name_en: Francophone Mobile Wallet Suspension & Unlock-Fee Scam
scams.signals_en: Callers pose as mobile operator or mobile wallet support in Madagascar and Haiti, warning that the recipient's wallet will be deactivated within twenty-four hours or announcing a blocked transfer.
scams.legit_en: Mobile operators and licensed mobile wallet providers in Madagascar and Haiti never ask subscribers to share a secret PIN over the phone, enter wallet credentials on external web links, or send peer-to-peer advance fees to unlock accounts or incoming.
bait_tactics: Attendez une petite minute, le réseau coupe énormément ici et le menu du téléphone ne s'affiche pas.
La carte SIM de mon portefeuille mobile est dans mon autre téléphone qui est déchargé dans la chambre.
Je n'ai pas mes lunettes sous la main pour lire le message, répétez-moi lentement le numéro de dossier.

scams.name: 假冒政府部門及公檢法電話騙案
scams.name_en: Government Department and Law Enforcement Impersonation
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from a local immigration, customs, or judicial police office, alleging the recipient's identity or phone number was used for illegal messages or money laundering.
scams.legit_en: Hong Kong and Macau government agencies never use pre-recorded alerts, never transfer calls directly to mainland law enforcement, and never ask citizens to disclose banking passwords, share phone screens, or transfer money to prove innocence.
bait_tactics: 不好意思，我現在在地下鐵車廂裡面訊號一直斷，你剛剛說的那個案件編號前兩碼是什麼？
我想配合你們核對，但我手邊沒帶身分證件，要等我回到家翻一下抽屜才能看清楚。
我的手機螢幕剛剛卡住點不開設定頁面，你要不要留個總機分機讓我晚點打過去？

scams.name: 假冒平台客服取消自動扣費騙案
scams.name_en: Fake Platform Customer Service Auto-Deduction Cancellation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller speaks Putonghua or accented Cantonese claiming to represent a shopping, short-video, or payment platform, stating the user enabled a paid membership or insurance plan that will deduct hefty monthly fees tonight.
scams.legit_en: Legitimate e-commerce, payment, and media platforms allow users to manage subscriptions directly inside their official apps and never telephone customers to request bank transfers, one-time passwords, or live screen sharing to cancel fees.
bait_tactics: 奇怪，我平時很少用那個平台，你等我找一下舊手機看看當初是用哪個電郵登記的。
我現在打開網上銀行一直轉圈載入不出來，公司網路好像擋住了，還是我自己進官方應用程式按取消？
你說今晚會扣款是嗎？但我這張卡裡面本來就只剩幾十塊錢，應該扣不到吧？

scams.name: 猜猜我是誰假冒親友急需保釋金騙案
scams.name_en: Guess Who I Am Relative Emergency Bail Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller opens vaguely by asking the recipient to guess who is speaking and claims they lost their phone or changed numbers.
scams.legit_en: Real police stations, courts, and hospitals in Hong Kong and Macau never phone family members to demand instant transfers to personal accounts or send couriers to collect cash bail on the street.
bait_tactics: 你聲音聽起來感冒很重，我實在聽不出來是哪位親戚，你先講你叫什麼名字？
這麼大件事我一個人做不了主，我現在先打去你原本那個舊電話號碼確認一下。
我今天沒帶提款卡出門，銀行櫃檯這個鐘點也排滿人，你要不要先找家裡其他人幫忙？

scams.name: 假冒電訊及郵電部門停機騙案
scams.name_en: Telecom Authority Urgent Service Termination Scam
scams.signals_en: The call claims to come from the local communications or postal-telecom authority, warning that the recipient's mobile service will be suspended within two hours because a SIM card registered under their name sent fraudulent messages elsewhere.
scams.legit_en: Telecommunications regulators in Hong Kong and Macau do not call individual subscribers about billing or line suspension, never ask for identity numbers over unsolicited calls, and never route calls to police investigators.
bait_tactics: 這個門號是我用了好幾年的月費卡，怎麼會突然停機？你把通知書寄到我帳單地址吧。
我現在手頭正在開會沒辦法抄寫，我自己下班後走去門市櫃檯查清楚好了。
你說我在外地開了電話卡，那你先告訴我開卡日期是幾月幾號，我完全沒印象。

QA.cross_border_note: Calls in Arabic or English, often from abroad or over WhatsApp.

scams.name: انتحال منصات الهوية الرقمية وطلب رمز التحقق
scams.name_en: Digital Identity App and OTP Verification Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to represent a government portal or telecom regulator, warning that the resident's national ID, residency file, or SIM registration will be suspended today.
scams.legit_en: Government portals, central banks, and telecom operators across Gulf states never ask residents to read one-time verification codes over the phone or approve unsolicited login requests inside digital identity applications.
bait_tactics: الشبكة عندي ضعيفة حالياً داخل المبنى ولم تصلني أي رسالة نصية، هل يمكنك الانتظار قليلاً حتى أتحرك لمكان فيه تغطية؟
التطبيق يطلب تحديثاً جديداً على الجوال والتحميل بطيء جداً، ما اسم القسم الرسمي الذي تتصل منه بالضبط؟
الشاشة علقت عندي وأنا أحاول فتح الإشعارات، أعد لي رقم المعاملة ببطء لو سمحت ريثما يفتح الجهاز.

scams.name: انتحال موظف البنك لتحديث الحساب وتجميد البطاقة
scams.name_en: Bank Account Freeze and KYC Update Call Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as bank customer support or central bank compliance staff, the caller warns that the victim's bank account and debit card are about to be frozen due to an expired ID record.
scams.legit_en: Banks and central banks across GCC countries require customers to update expired identification only in branch or directly inside verified official banking apps, and never request CVV numbers or OTP codes by phone.
bait_tactics: محفظتي في الغرفة الثانية ولا أحفظ أرقام البطاقة عن ظهر قلب، انتظر لحظة أبحث عنها ولكن الخط يقطع قليلاً.
لدي أكثر من حساب بنكي ولا أعرف أي بطاقة تقصدون، هل تذكر لي الفرع المسجل لديكم أولاً؟
حاولت فتح تطبيق البنك للتأكد لكن يظهر لي خطأ في الاتصال بالإنترنت، أمهلني دقيقة أعيد تشغيل الشبكة.

scams.name: انتحال صفة الشرطة أو الجهات الأمنية والمالية
scams.name_en: Police and Financial Authority Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from criminal investigations or financial crime police, alleging suspicious transfers on the resident's bank account.
scams.legit_en: Police departments across Gulf states repeatedly confirm that officers never call individuals to ask for bank card details, verification codes, or money transfers; official inquiries take place through formal police channels.
bait_tactics: الصوت غير واضح بسبب التكييف عندي، هل يمكنك إعادة اسم الإدارة ورقم البلاغ ببطء حتى أكتبه؟
أبحث الآن عن ورقة وقلم لتدوين المعلومات، لكن الهاتف الآخر يرن في نفس الوقت، ثانية واحدة معك.
لم تصلني أي إشعارات رسمية على هاتفي، هل يمكنك توضيح تاريخ المعاملة التي تتحدث عنها بالضبط؟

الشاشة علقت عندي وأنا أحاول فتح الإشعارات، أعد لي رقم المعاملة ببطء لو سمحت ريثما يفتح الجهاز.

scams.name: انتحال موظف البنك لتحديث الحساب وتجميد البطاقة
scams.name_en: Bank Account Freeze and KYC Update Call Scam
scams.signals_en: Posing as bank customer support or central bank compliance staff, the caller warns that the victim's bank account and debit card are about to be frozen due to an expired ID record.
scams.legit_en: Banks and central banks across GCC countries require customers to update expired identification only in branch or directly inside verified official banking apps, and never request CVV numbers or OTP codes by phone.
bait_tactics: محفظتي في الغرفة الثانية ولا أحفظ أرقام البطاقة عن ظهر قلب، انتظر لحظة أبحث عنها ولكن الخط يقطع قليلاً.
لدي أكثر من حساب بنكي ولا أعرف أي بطاقة تقصدون، هل تذكر لي الفرع المسجل لديكم أولاً؟
حاولت فتح تطبيق البنك للتأكد لكن يظهر لي خطأ في الاتصال بالإنترنت، أمهلني دقيقة أعيد تشغيل الشبكة.

scams.name: انتحال صفة الشرطة أو الجهات الأمنية والمالية
scams.name_en: Police and Financial Authority Impersonation Scam
scams.signals_en: The caller claims to be from criminal investigations or financial crime police, alleging suspicious transfers on the resident's bank account.
scams.legit_en: Police departments across Gulf states repeatedly confirm that officers never call individuals to ask for bank card details, verification codes, or money transfers; official inquiries take place through formal police channels.
bait_tactics: الصوت غير واضح بسبب التكييف عندي، هل يمكنك إعادة اسم الإدارة ورقم البلاغ ببطء حتى أكتبه؟
أبحث الآن عن ورقة وقلم لتدوين المعلومات، لكن الهاتف الآخر يرن في نفس الوقت، ثانية واحدة معك.
لم تصلني أي إشعارات رسمية على هاتفي، هل يمكنك توضيح تاريخ المعاملة التي تتحدث عنها بالضبط؟
